ഈ കര്‍മത്തില്‍ ഓരോരുത്തരും ആയിത്തീരുകയാണ്. ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള ഒരു കര്‍മശേഷി നമ്മളില്‍ പകര്‍ന്നുനിന്നിട്ട് അത് അറിഞ്ഞുകൂടാ, കണ്ടുകൂടാ, കേട്ടുകൂടാ എന്നു പറയുന്നത് അറിവുകേടല്ലേ? ദൈവമായിട്ടു നമുക്കു തന്ന ഈ ധന്യത ഗുരുപൂജ ചെയ്തിട്ട് നിങ്ങളില്‍ക്കൂടി നിങ്ങളുടെ മക്കളില്‍ക്കൂടി, അവരുടെ പരമ്പരയില്‍ക്കൂടി സത്യമാക്കി സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്ന കര്‍മമാണ് ശാന്തിഗിരിയുടേത്.
ഗുരുവാണി

ഗുരുവിനെ നാലുവിധത്തില്‍ പറയുന്നു - ബ്രഹ്മവിത്ത്, ബ്രഹ്മവര്യന്‍, ബ്രഹ്മവരിഷ്ഠന്‍, ബ്രഹ്മവരീഷ്ഠാന്‍. പലരും എഴുതിയപ്പോള്‍ മാറിപ്പോയ ചരിത്രവും കര്‍മശേഷിയും ഒരു വലിയ ആപത്തുപോലെ നമ്മെ പിണഞ്ഞു നില്‍ക്കുന്നു. അത് ഓരോന്നായി എടുത്തു കാണണം. എവിടെയും മുട്ട എന്നൊരു പ്രയോഗം കാണാം. മുട്ടയ്ക്ക് ഉരുണ്ട ആകൃതിയാണല്ലോ. അതായത് ഉല്‍പത്തിയുടെ ആദിമഘട്ടം മുതല്‍ അണ്ഡകടാഹത്തിന്‍റെ ആകൃതിയാണ് കൈക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നത്. അത് ആമ എന്ന ഉഭയജീവിവരെ വന്നു നില്‍ക്കുന്നു. പന്നി മുതല്‍ പ്രസവയോനി എന്ന പരിണാമം വരെ വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു. പരിണാമഗതിയില്‍ ഉല്‍പത്തി മുതലേ അബദ്ധം വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു എന്നു കാണാന്‍ ഇതില്‍പരം ഒരു ദൃഷ്ടാന്തം വേണ്ട. പ്രസവിക്കുന്ന അവസ്ഥയില്‍ ഒരു ജീവന്‍ പരിണമിച്ചെത്തുന്നത് എത്രയോ ദീര്‍ഘമായ കാലം കൊണ്ടാണ്. ലോകത്ത് ഏതൊരു വസ്തുവിനെ എടുത്തു നോക്കിയാലും പരിണാമഗതി ഇപ്രകാരം തന്നെയാണ്.

കാലത്തിന്‍റെ പഴക്കത്തിലേക്കു ചിന്തിച്ചാല്‍ രണ്ടോ മൂന്നോ മൈലുകള്‍ക്കപ്പുറത്തുപോലും ചെന്നെത്താനാകാത്ത ഗതികേടു നമുക്കുണ്ട്. അതുകൊണ്ട് കാലത്തിന്‍റെ തുടക്കം ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന്‍റെ കാലം മുതല്‍ എടുക്കുന്നതാണ് ഉചിതം. പരിണാമകഥയെ സംബന്ധിച്ച കഥമുടച്ചില്‍ കാരണം ഒരൊറ്റ ആചാര്യനും പ്രവര്‍ത്തിച്ചു മുന്നില്‍വരാന്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല. ആ കഥമുടച്ചില്‍ സത്യമല്ല എന്നുകണ്ട കുഞ്ചന്‍നമ്പ്യാരെയും എഴുത്തച്ഛനെയും പോലുള്ള ചില കവികള്‍ ചില സത്യങ്ങള്‍ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ട്. അതും തുറന്നു പറയാനൊക്കാത്തതുകൊണ്ട് അവരുടെ കഴിവിനനുസരിച്ച് പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ട്. പുറകോട്ടു നോക്കിയാല്‍ എത്രയോ വലിയ വേദാന്തികളെയും സിദ്ധാന്തികളെയും കര്‍മി, ജ്ഞാനി, ഭക്തന്‍ എന്നിവരെയും പഠിച്ചാലും യാതൊന്നും മനസ്സിലാക്കാനാവില്ല. ഓരോരുത്തരുമെഴുതി കഴിവിന്‍റെ ആ ഭാഗം എടുത്തു കാണിക്കുന്ന കൂട്ടത്തില്‍ കാലാന്തര മാര്‍ഗപ്പിഴവുകള്‍ വന്നു. ഈ കുലത്തിന്‍റെ അവസ്ഥാമാറ്റത്തില്‍ ഒരു ഗുരുപരമ്പര കൈവന്നില്ലെങ്കില്‍ പിഴവുകള്‍ തിരുത്താന്‍ കഴിയില്ല. ഒരു പുതിയ ചിന്ത ഉത്ഭവിച്ചാല്‍ത്തന്നെ അതിന് ആത്മീയവുമായി ഒരു ബന്ധവും ഉണ്ടാവുകയില്ല. പഠിപ്പിന്‍റെ സ്ഥാനം നോക്കുമ്പോഴും അങ്ങനെ തന്നെ. ജ്ഞാനത്തിന്‍റെ നന്മകൊണ്ട് ഒരു ജീവിതകാലം നല്ലതുപോലെ പോയെന്നു വരാം. കാളിദാസന്‍റെ കഥയും അങ്ങനെതന്നെ മുടഞ്ഞെടുത്ത കഥകളിലൊന്നാണ്. ആട്ടിടയന്‍ രാജകുമാരിയെ കല്യാണം കഴിച്ചതായും അകത്താര് എന്നു ചോദിച്ചപ്പോള്‍ പുറത്താര് എന്നു തിരിച്ചു ചോദിച്ചതായും പറയപ്പെടുന്നതുപോലുള്ള കഥ മുടഞ്ഞപ്പോള്‍ ഒരാള്‍ക്കും നേരു പറയാന്‍ കഴിയാത്ത നിലവന്നു. ഇന്ത്യയില്‍ അങ്ങോളമിങ്ങോളമുള്ള കഥയെഴുത്ത് ഇതുപോലെതന്നെയാണ്. വലിയ ഭക്തനായ ഹനുമാനും അക്കാലത്തു ജീവിച്ചിരുന്ന ഒരു വലിയ മഹാനായ ശ്രീരാമനും ഈ കഥമുടച്ചിലില്‍ അകപ്പെട്ടു.

ഇങ്ങനെ ഒന്നൊഴിയാതെ ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ധര്‍മത്തില്‍ പിടിച്ചു കുലുക്കിയ കര്‍മത്തില്‍ പിശകി മരിക്കാതിരിക്കാന്‍ കെട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ചതുപോലെ തോന്നും ഇതൊക്കെക്കണ്ടാല്‍. ഏതെല്ലാം യുഗങ്ങളില്‍ ഏതെല്ലാം യുഗധര്‍മങ്ങളില്‍ക്കൂടി എത്രയെല്ലാം മഹാന്മാര്‍ വന്നിട്ടുണ്ടോ അവരെ എല്ലാം കവികളും മതവിശ്വാസികളുംചേര്‍ന്ന് അവരുടെ ഭാഷയുടെ ശേഷിക്കൊത്ത് കഥ മുടഞ്ഞു സൂക്ഷിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. ഈ കാരണത്താല്‍ ഈശ്വരഭജന സത്യമായി ചെയ്തെടുക്കാന്‍ വയ്യാതായി. ഈ കഥ എഴുതിയതിനൊപ്പിച്ച് അതിനെ കര്‍മത്തില്‍ കൊണ്ടുവന്ന് കര്‍മശേഷി വരുത്താനും ബുദ്ധിയില്‍ ധരിച്ചും ധരിപ്പിച്ചും വയ്ക്കാനും പരിശ്രമിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. ഇതു കര്‍മനാശത്തിന് ഇടവരുത്തി. നാശത്തിന് ഇടവരുത്തിയ ഈ കര്‍മം സത്യമോ അസത്യമോ എന്നു പറയേണ്ട ഉത്തരവാദിത്വവും ഈ പണ്ഡിതന്‍മാര്‍ക്കുണ്ട്. ഇതില്‍പ്പെടുന്ന ചില പണ്ഡിതന്‍മാരും ഉണ്ട്. അവരാണ് ആദ്യം സൂചിപ്പിച്ച ബ്രഹ്മവിത്ത് തുടങ്ങിയ നാലുവിധം ഗുരുക്കന്മാര്‍.

ഈ നാലു കൂട്ടര്‍ ചുരുങ്ങി മൂന്നു കൂട്ടരായി മാറി. അതായത് നാലാമത്തെ ജ്ഞാനമുഖം (നാന്‍മുഖത്വം) ഇല്ലാതായെന്നും തന്‍മൂലം കലിധര്‍മം നടന്നില്ലെന്നുമാണ് അര്‍ത്ഥം. ഈ ധര്‍മലോപം ലോകത്തിനൊപ്പം വളര്‍ന്നു നില്‍ക്കുന്നു. അതിന്‍റെ ഫലമായി തത്ത്വശാസ്ത്രങ്ങള്‍ ഭാഷയും ഭൂഷണവും കൊണ്ടു മോടിപിടിപ്പിച്ചു ബുദ്ധികൊണ്ടു കളിച്ച കൈയാങ്കളിയായി. ഈ വഴിക്ക് ദൈവത്തെ വിളിച്ചു തുടങ്ങിയാല്‍ എവിടം മുതല്‍ വിളിക്കേണ്ടി വരും, എവിടെക്കൊണ്ടെത്തിക്കും? ഈശ്വരഭജനയിലെ ഈ ദോഷവശം പഴയതെന്നോ പുതിയതെന്നോ ഇല്ലാത്തതാണെന്ന് ബുദ്ധികൊണ്ടു പറഞ്ഞാല്‍ ഇല്ലാതാകുന്നില്ല.

ഇത് പ്രകൃതിയായിത്തീര്‍ന്നിരിക്കുന്നു. പ്രകൃതി ഒരിക്കലും ഇല്ലാതാകുന്നില്ല. ബുദ്ധി മൊത്തമായിട്ടു ചൊരിഞ്ഞാലും ഒരു രാജ്യത്തിന്‍റെ നടത്തിപ്പുതന്നെ കൈവശം കിട്ടിയാലും ഇതിനെ നന്നാക്കാന്‍ കഴിയുകയില്ല. ഉള്ളതിനെ ഇല്ലാതായിട്ടും ഇല്ലാത്തതിനെ ഉള്ളതായിട്ടും പറയുന്ന തത്ത്വശാസ്ത്രങ്ങളിലെ ഭാഗം മഹാത്മാക്കളുടെ വളര്‍ച്ചയെ തടസ്സപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു. അങ്ങനെ പണ്ഡിതന്മാര്‍ അവരവരുടെ ഭാഗം എഴുതി ഫലിപ്പിച്ച് എല്ലാത്തരത്തിലും മുടിച്ചു വളര്‍ത്തി ഇന്നോളം വന്ന സകല കവികളും ലോകത്തെ വെപ്പാട്ടിയായി സൂക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു. അതിനു ദൃഷ്ടാന്തമാണ് ഇടയച്ചെറുക്കന്‍ രാജകുമാരിയെ കല്യാണം കഴിച്ച കഥയും രാമന്‍റെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ഭക്തനായിരുന്നിട്ടും ഹനുമാന് വാലു പിടിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതും. ഈ പൊട്ടന്‍ കഥകളില്‍പ്പിടിച്ച് ധര്‍മത്തെ പൂര്‍ത്തിയാക്കാന്‍ കഴിയില്ല. അതിനെപ്പിടിച്ചിട്ടും കാര്യമില്ല.

പിടിക്കേണ്ട എന്നു പറഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ട് അതില്ലാത്തതാണെന്ന് അര്‍ത്ഥമില്ല. പേരുകൊണ്ട് ഉച്ചരിക്കുന്നതെല്ലാം ഉള്ളതു തന്നെ. നമ്മള്‍ എന്നു പറയുമ്പോള്‍ ഇന്ത്യാക്കാര്‍ മാത്രമാണെന്നു ധരിക്കരുത്. ലോകത്തിനെ ആകെ ഈ തെറ്റു ബാധിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു. അതുകൊണ്ട് ലോകത്തെ സകല ഭരണകര്‍ത്താക്കളും തെറ്റിയിരിക്കുന്നു. ഈ ഓരോ വ്യക്തിയുടെയും കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങള്‍ ജനിച്ചു വളരുമ്പോള്‍ വികൃതിയുടെ കോമരങ്ങളായിത്തീരാനാണ് അവരുടെ ഈ വേല. ഒടുവില്‍ ഓടിയവനും ഓടിച്ചവനും കാലുകഴപ്പ് ഒരുപോലെ ആയിത്തീരും.

ഈശ്വരാനുഗ്രഹമില്ലാതെപോയ കുറെ പണ്ഡിതന്മാരും അവരുടെ അനുയായികളുമായിട്ടു കഥയെഴുതി കഥകളിയാക്കിയപ്പോള്‍ കളിയുടെ കൂത്തരങ്ങു വലുതാക്കാന്‍ ഗുരുവിനെ അഥവാ പ്രവാചകനെ ഉപയോഗപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്ന വിധത്തിലാണ് അവരുടെ നാടകരചന. ഈ രീതിയെ തിരുത്താന്‍ വന്ന ആളാണു വ്യാസന്‍. എന്നിട്ട് വ്യാസന്‍ എഴുതി വച്ചതോ? നാലു മുഖമായിട്ടു തിരിച്ചു നാലു വേദമാക്കി. അതിനു മുന്‍പേ തന്നെ അതിനെ ആറു ശാസ്ത്രവും പതിനെട്ടു പുരാണവുമാക്കിയിരുന്നു. അതിനെ തിരുത്താനാണു വ്യാസന്‍ വന്നത്. ഇവ സ്തുതിഗീതങ്ങളായി നില്‍ക്കുകയല്ലാതെ ഇവയെയൊക്കെ പൊളിച്ചെഴുതി തിരിച്ചെടുക്കാന്‍ എളുപ്പമാണോ? അതുകൊണ്ട് ആ വഴിക്കു നമ്മള്‍ നോക്കേണ്ടതില്ല.

നമുക്കു കിട്ടിയ ഈ അറിവ് ദൈവം കാണിച്ചുതന്നതാണ്. അതിനെ തികച്ചും വിശ്വസിച്ച് ആദരിച്ച് സ്നേഹപ്പെടുത്തി എടുക്കേണ്ട ഒരു കര്‍മമാണ് ഇന്നു നമ്മള്‍ കണ്ടെത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നത്. സൂര്യനും ചന്ദ്രനും ഭൂമിയും സമനില തെറ്റാതെ കറങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു. കറുത്തപക്ഷം വെളുത്തപക്ഷം എന്നു രണ്ടു പക്ഷങ്ങള്‍ ഇരുപത്തിയേഴു നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളെ ചുവടുപിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ട് ഫലപ്രഖ്യാപനം ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നു. ഭൂമിയുടെ ഭൗതികശാസ്ത്രവും യാമക്കണക്കില്‍പ്പെടുത്തി ആഗോളവൃത്തത്തിന്‍റെ കഥപറഞ്ഞു മോചിപ്പിക്കാന്‍ നോക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു. ഇത്തരം തെറ്റുകള്‍ എല്ലാ ഗോളങ്ങളെ സംബന്ധിച്ചും വരുത്തിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. ഇതു ചിന്തിച്ചാല്‍ കിട്ടുന്നതല്ല. ചിന്താതീതം, ബുദ്ധ്യാതീതം എന്ന് ഈ പണ്ഡിതന്മാര്‍ തന്നെ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ട്. അവരുടെ തത്ത്വങ്ങളെ ദര്‍ശനമെന്നും യോഗമെന്നും പലതരത്തില്‍ സിദ്ധാന്തീകരിച്ചും കാണുന്നു. ഇതിലൊന്നും ആര്‍ക്കും തൊടാന്‍പോലും പാടില്ല. ഇതു കൈകാര്യം ചെയ്യാന്‍ ഗുരുക്കന്‍മാരാണു വേണ്ടത്. നമ്മളുടെ സങ്കല്‍പത്തിലും അറിവിലും വന്നിട്ടുള്ള ഗുരുമാര്‍ഗത്തെയല്ല ഇവിടെ ഉദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നത്.

മനുധര്‍മത്തെ ഏതു കാലം മുതല്‍ തെറ്റിച്ചോ, അപ്പോള്‍ മുതല്‍ ഉള്ളതാണ് ബ്രഹ്മശാപം. അതു നിവര്‍ത്തിക്കാന്‍ പഠിപ്പാളിയെക്കൊണ്ടും പഠിപ്പില്ലാത്തവനെക്കൊണ്ടും സാധ്യമല്ല. എന്നാല്‍ ബ്രഹ്മനിശ്ചയത്താല്‍ വരുന്ന അനേകം മഹാത്മാക്കളുണ്ട്. ഒരു ചതുര്‍യുഗത്തില്‍ അങ്ങനെയുള്ള ഇരുപത്തിയൊന്നു ഗുരുക്കന്മാര്‍ വരും. അവര്‍ ആരെയും ബോദ്ധ്യപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതിനുവേണ്ടി ഒന്നും എഴുതിവയ്ക്കില്ല. കഴിഞ്ഞുപോയ കാലങ്ങളുടെ തെറ്റും ശരിയും കണ്ടിട്ട് അതിനെ തിരുത്തുക എന്നതാണ് ഈ ഗുരുക്കന്മാരുടെ ധര്‍മം. അതേസമയം തെറ്റിലൂടെ വന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ഘടനാവിശേഷത്തെ മാറ്റാന്‍ അയാള്‍ക്കു സാധ്യമല്ല. എത്രയോ രാമന്‍മാരും എത്രയോ ബുദ്ധന്‍മാരും എത്രയോ യേശുമാരും നബികളും വന്നിരിക്കുന്നു. അവരെല്ലാം വേദനയോടെ സാക്ഷ്യപ്പെടുത്താനല്ലാതെ മനുഷ്യലോകത്തിന് എന്തെങ്കിലും ചെയ്യാന്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ടോ? നാവും വായും അവരുടെ അറിവിനു വഴങ്ങാതെ വന്നപ്പോള്‍ അതിനെ നിരാകരിച്ചിട്ട് ത്രിമുഖം ബലപ്പെടുത്തി. ജ്ഞാനമുഖം നുള്ളിക്കളഞ്ഞെന്ന് എഴുതിവയ്ക്കുകയും ചെയ്തു. അങ്ങനെ എഴുതിവച്ചാല്‍ കര്‍മം, കര്‍മിച്ചു പോയ മണ്ഡലത്തില്‍ നിന്നു മാറാന്‍ പോകുന്നില്ല. അത് മനസ്സുകൊണ്ടു കണ്ടാലും മാംസക്കണ്ണുകൊണ്ടു കണ്ടാലും അന്തരീക്ഷമാലിന്യങ്ങളായി സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്നു.
ഓരോ മഹാന്മാര്‍ വരുമ്പോഴും അവര്‍ക്കുവേണ്ട ബുദ്ധിയും കഴിവും ഒക്കെ ദൈവം കൊടുക്കുന്നുണ്ട്. എന്നാല്‍ നമ്മള്‍ ഈ മഹാന്മാരെയൊക്കെ ഉപദ്രവിച്ചു ചീത്തയാക്കുകയാണു ചെയ്തിട്ടുള്ളത്.

ചിന്താതീതമായി നില്‍ക്കുന്ന സ്ഥൂലസൂക്ഷ്മങ്ങളും കാരണകാര്യങ്ങളും എക്കാലത്ത് എങ്ങനെയെല്ലാം നടന്നിരുന്നു എന്നു കാണുകയാണ് ശിഷ്യന്‍റെ ലഘുത്വം. അത് കഥമുടച്ചിലില്‍ക്കൂടി കടന്നു പോയാല്‍ ഈ ശിഷ്യന്‍ കുഴിയില്‍ വീഴും. എന്നാല്‍ യഥാര്‍ത്ഥത്തില്‍ വന്ന ഗുരുവില്‍ക്കൂടിപ്പോയാല്‍ ഈ അബദ്ധം വരുകയില്ല. ഈ ഗുരു ഒരു മേന്മയും കാണിക്കുകയില്ല. ഈ ഗുരു ഇരുപത്തിയഞ്ചു ചതുര്‍യുഗത്തിന്‍റെ കണക്കു പറയാന്‍ പ്രാപ്തനായിരിക്കും. ഈ ഗുരുവെപ്പിടിച്ച് സകലകര്‍മത്തില്‍ക്കൂടിയും സഞ്ചരിക്കാം. ഈ സകലകര്‍മത്തിലും ഗുരുവും താനും ഉള്ളതായിട്ട് ദര്‍ശനമുള്ള ശിഷ്യന്‍ കാണുന്നു. കണ്ടിട്ട് ഗുരുവിനോട് പറഞ്ഞു തിരുത്തു വാങ്ങും.

ത്രിമൂര്‍ത്തിപരമ്പരയും മനുപരമ്പരയും ഇല്ലാത്തതല്ല. ആ സത്യം അവിടെ നിന്നോട്ടെ. നമ്മള്‍ കാണേണ്ടതു മറ്റൊന്നാണ്. മുട്ടയുടെ ആകൃതിയായ അണ്ഡകടാഹത്തില്‍ എന്തെല്ലാം വിധത്തിലുള്ള മുട്ടയുണ്ട്. ആ മുട്ടയില്‍ എന്തെല്ലാം ചേര്‍ന്നിരിക്കും, അതില്‍ നേരത്തെ സൂചിപ്പിച്ച എല്ലാ പ്രകാശങ്ങളും വരും. ആ പ്രകാശത്തെ നമ്മള്‍ കണ്ടാലും കണ്ടില്ലെങ്കിലും വിശ്വാസികളും സ്നേഹമുള്ളവരും ചേര്‍ന്ന് മുനിജനസേവയില്‍ മൂര്‍ത്തി നിര്‍ത്തിടേണം എന്ന ശ്രീനാരായണഗുരുവിന്‍റെ വാക്കിനെ മാനിക്കണം. ആ സ്ഥാനത്ത് ആണോ പെണ്ണോ ചെറുതോ വലുതോ എന്ന വ്യത്യാസമില്ല. ലോകത്തിന്‍റെ തെറ്റുകള്‍ തിരുത്തി മുന്നോട്ടു പോവുക. ഇതാണ് ഒരു യഥാര്‍ത്ഥശിഷ്യന്‍റെ കടമ. ഈ ശിഷ്യനെയാണ് ശിഷ്യസമ്പത്ത് എന്നു പറയാവുന്നത്. ഈ രീതിയില്‍ ശാന്തിഗിരിയില്‍ ഉപയോഗപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു എന്ന സത്യം നിങ്ങളെ അറിയിക്കുകയാണ്.
ഗുരുവാണി
en: February 2000

Most of us cannot maintain the discipline of the ashram. We must know one thing. No other ashram in Kerala or even in India has a discipline like that of our ashram. Hospitality is the greatest etiquette of the ashram. Whether a king comes, we will receive him. Whether a beggar comes, we will receive him. There is a specific way for everyone according to the ashram's rules. No show-offs are allowed there. The ashram should be considered the greatest. Humility is its defining feature. That is enough for us, let us do it this way - this is the attitude and language in the ashram. When I went to Kalady, very rich Nairs were the workers there. There are some Brahmins. They will not eat tempering with onions. Onion is considered asuric. This is a kind of guise. They don't know that onion is strictly a medicine.

We must have studied the great sannyasins. We shouldn't behave with them like ignorant people. There is caste in your very behavior. If they see a brahmachari, sannyasins will be very careful. If one is a brahmachari, he should wear a reasonably proper mundu or a towel. There should be another cloth separately to wipe sweat. When coming among people, this towel must be kept aside before coming. No one should be allowed to touch it. They should not use a vessel used by someone else. These are the rules of a brahmachari.

Everyone should know the discipline of the ashram. Society should be brought to peace by learning and teaching the ashram discipline. A discipline has been established here that brings a sense of respectability to Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras alike. That respectability has been brought even to the dressing style of men and women. I have established this by struggling and thinking, evaluating the karmas, dharmas, and customs that have occurred over the ages. I am not just exercising authority for the sake of it. I have not spoken anything that is not factual. Most people are unable to realize what I have done. The youngsters standing here, boys and girls, are copying this ignorance.

I have studied the places I interacted with very well. The people of Varkala are innocent. No one in Kadakkavoor, Vakkom, Nedunganda, or Kayikkara can be controlled. There is a mix-up among men and women in big houses. It is more in Karunagappally and Karthikappally. It is all a kind of vulgarity. The people of Varkala learned this and became spoiled. Thus our culture fell far behind. If we go north, except for Palakkad, everywhere else has a different discipline. That is not the discipline of Hindus. It is the discipline of Muslims and Christians. The culture of Palakkad district stands apart from all this.

What I meant is, the brahmacharis standing here have nothing to learn from anywhere else. Because all existing ashrams are on the English model. If you see the children coming from Sivagiri, you will understand that. They also have a kind of descent and mingling, twisting and turning among men and women. More than the girls coming from outside, you have to be careful with women above thirty years of age. It is very difficult to correct them. Because, they will have some kind of arrogance. I am not saying you should see them as bad when they come here. You should tell them we don't need that anymore. They will obey that. We must pay attention to our lives. We shouldn't get stuck in the pampering of our mothers. What is the pampering of mothers? Mothers have one behavior in houses without boys. Another behavior in houses with boys. This is the pampering of mothers. The girls coming here from these houses do not know any of this behavior. But they also don't know the behavior here. You should tell those coming here what the discipline of this ashram is. You have nothing to learn from them.

What do Ezhavas and Nairs think an ashram is? All they know is not to eat fish, be pure, shouldn't even walk through that compound - that much only. They know nothing else. You do not understand what all I am doing to fix a house. You don't even understand why I scold those standing near me. I will draw everyone near and push them away at the same time. That is a matter only I know. If I see incompetence, I will draw them near. If incompetence is seen, pushing them away saying they are useless, not good, is dangerous.

What is the nature of an ashram? An ashram is a place that corrects the useless and makes use of the good. It will do everything possible to make use of them. Only then will his karma increase. Otherwise, he will become waste. Your knowledge about ashrams is limited. The only ashrams you have seen are Sivagiri and Sri Ramakrishna Mission - both are ashrams of sannyasins. Very few have come there as brahmacharis. If someone shows a little devotion, others will cry out, "Oh, he became a sannyasi." Hearing this, this sannyasi will feel elevated. He might be longing to get the respectability of a sannyasi. For someone who already has one or two children, this talk will be an added encouragement. Then he will renounce everything! Such useless sannyasa exists there. They might have education and wealth. They are good at spoiling others. He is someone who grew up through this filth, isn't he? He didn't become a brahmachari and leave. If a sixty-year-old man goes and stays in some ashram for two days and comes back, the women at home will ask, "Do you need all this now?" Then he will get such publicity in the native place too.

We ourselves must realize that our people lack knowledge. We must change them from this lack. That is the prayer in this ashram. When doing this prayer, not just them, but all the great souls who wished to walk the path of truth in the worship methods that have occurred till today are getting liberated from their shortcomings.

What is this liberation? It is not the liberation mentioned in the Puranas or Vedic hymns. It is the liberation that is the knowledge known by the great souls themselves about when their karmic flaws occurred, how long it will take to be resolved, and when they will return amidst humanity after that. God is leading us to such a karma. Marrying off men and women here and keeping them here to perform certain sankalpas is for the arrival of these great souls. Its sign will be shown to them even before the child is born. At least twenty-five out of a hundred people will get these signs in a vision.

What is your understanding when you say vision? Even the one who practiced chathan seva (black magic) shows plenty of special siddhis once he gets a vision. Amazed by that, we fall into adharma just like following the path of people afflicted with karmic flaws. This is like the adharma of lighting a lamp and worshipping the ghost of someone who died in an accident. Not knowing what all will happen to us and our children if we worship all this, even foreign countries show a lot of sorcery nature. They are called civilized. You must think about where all this demon goes and shows this. A truth shown by God to bring a change from this is this ashram and the prayer here. Each one of you are the children entitled to achieve this fortune. Children born in any part of the world after nineteen seventy-three especially have that fortune.

This change will not come running immediately. After every Jupiter cycle (12 years), there will be a change in the world's government. All this governing nature seen today will be changed. This change will be through these children. Coming like that, these children will work and show what this world's dharma is, and how the karmic flaws will change. It will happen completely for your third generation. God is making the guidance of such a great theory happen here.
Guru Vani
March 2000
The world has had a prayer system at all times. But what is the prayer in Santhigiri? What is it for?

The prayer at Santhigiri is a prayer given by God to rectify all the shortcomings of whatever types of householders there are in the world, and whatever shortcomings we have. So you must have an intention - we will do this prayer to the best of our ability, according to our capacity and knowledge, and the rest must be provided by God. For that, we will go through the path given by God.

Through that, you should develop an idea of how your children should be. It is for that, householders are retained here and many things have been set up for them here. But most of you have the misfortune of not being able to obey it.

Why? Not because nobody wants it. Your tendencies grip everything tightly. "I want to be good, I should be useful to everyone"ڈ - such desires exist in at least some. But whatever desires you have, this tendency intertwines with life in a way that cannot be eliminated. This karmic flaw drags you down. By keeping any kind of hollowness or vanity, no one can change this karmic flaw that has become a tendency.

What should we understand when we say householder? In what our ancestors believed and worshipped till today, there are those entitled to get peace, qualified to get liberation, and qualified for mukti. We have maintained everything according to its respective qualification. We have not heard of this idea till today. It includes pitru, devas, devi, rishi, sannyasi, and everything. It is difficult for us to know all this. Or even if known, how many can fulfill it? It cannot be done by any of you.

This must be done. If you cannot do it, your children must do it. The means for that purification I have told everyone till today - Guru Pooja! This purification - pitru purification, deva purification, rishi purification - no one has been able to maintain, and no one is able to. From each karma prescribed for that, all of you are going backward. This is my experience till today. This is something that doesn't happen even if you wish for it. That is, it's not that nobody has the desire. Some kind of inabilities happen.

Wishing to get a change from this misfortune and making others wish, some men and women come and stay here. They also do the work they can. But no one is able to do it properly. For this, prayers have been conducted here at different periods. Due to the mistakes that happened traditionally to us and our close ones, we are unable to take this. Therefore, passing that goodness to future generations, at least through them, we must be able to bring that goodness to all people. It is not enough if that goodness comes only to our land or country, that goodness must come to the whole world. All the hardships of the world must go away. All the troubles that have come in the governments of the world must go away - this should be your constant sankalpa.

We are moving forward doing such a karma. What is it? God has gifted us a karma that helps towards the possibility of liberation, or the possibility of mukti for pitrus, devas, rishis, sannyasins, and everything. And God Himself is making us do it. Because we are not capable of achieving it. But then you might think, why make us struggle like this, couldn't God Himself just do it? It's not like that.
Millions of gurus and their followers came for this. They could not achieve it. There is a reason for it.

In the aspect of the knowledge passed down as Sanatana and Hindu, we are nobody. But we have to take this back. Through us, through our children, the world must get this. This is our goal. For that, the prayer given to us by God is our prayer.

There are so many crores of souls in the subtle atmosphere who have completed in the deva karma. They all must get liberation. In addition, there are lakhs of souls called rishis and sannyasins, and rishis and sannyasins who have gone below and above the deva. We have mostly heard about the rishis and sannyasins who have gone in the prayer of the deva. But there are souls standing beyond that. Although these souls can remain in higher planes, they cannot get liberated. The reason is that they cannot cross according to the ordinances of time's dharma.

We can see; the karmic power acquired by each lineage of prophets, each Guru lineage, and each religious theorist is varied. In many, there are mistakes that occurred due to the far-sightedness of various karmas. The capability to change this karmic power is lacking for that soul. We and our ancestors do not have that capability. Because there are crores of souls standing across the deva status with crores of rishis in the nature of Hindus or Sanatanis, and prophets and apostles. What understanding do we have regarding them? However, those who came by God's will have tried to say some things up to their vision. We haven't been able to take at least that much. The reason we couldn't is that we could not recognize Sanatana and Hindu.

When the Hindu theory was mixed up, it had only three faces. Shaktheya, Shaiva, Vaishnava, or Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva - we are groping at the bottom of what was said and fixed like this. That path of karma, which has been operating from its beginning till today, has become the foundation for this world. It is not easy to change this. Who is it impossible for? For the lakhs of gurus and acharyas who came before. We can do it. Only we can do it. In the righteous initiation mentioned by those great souls, they have seen and told the difficulties or obstacles that came to them.

When determining the time of great souls, it should be taken at least from the time of Sree Rama. It is not enough to take the prophets, gurus, or acharyas who came recently. We must repeatedly fulfill them, their lineage, and the obstacles they faced, which they themselves have revealed. For that, God has gifted us the prayer and Guru's path at Santhigiri.
Guru Vani
April 2000

It is said that Sree Rama was born after performing the karma called Putrakameshti. That is, God desired to bring good souls. Even the family life of such a Sree Rama had no peace. Then how will people like us be saved? But that Brahma power itself is doing everything to bring good souls among us. We must see it to its magnitude. Otherwise, we won't even be able to take it.

In the name of worship, we are holding onto something, covering it all up, praying, intending, and tying our souls to it. This is the biggest danger that has happened to us. God allowed the time of Kali for us to overcome this. Without telling us what that Kali dharma is, a word was cunningly said regarding Kali, and a word was also said that it is bad - Kali for Shudras. When it was said Kali for Shudras, everyone thought it was for some lower caste people. Lower caste people couldn't even enter the temple. Later, permission was obtained to enter the temple. But that was for the achievement of the Vaidikas.

In the old days, Vaidikas would not come among the people. Or if they came, they would only stay in some temple precincts. They would do some tantra or yantra and command the temple officials. They would obey that. However, only seven families had the authority to enter the temple. Starting from Illathu Nair, to Kartha, Unni, Menon, and finally Vilakkithala Nair. No one else could enter the temple. They also created some administrative power to make it seem that they were weak and useless. This happened all over India. When this situation came, only these seven families - Dasi families - were brought up inside the temple and kept in the absurdity called sambandham. Thus, a path that endangered the vast majority of people was brought about through the temple systems. Going astray as Devadasis, they grew up and perished without ever having the right to mukti or liberation. These people also didn't learn to use the intellect and reasoning given by God properly. The temple dwellers first learned this wayward behavior. They taught everyone else. The realm of knowledge that was closed by that teaching never opened to the light again. Vaikom Satyagraha is a proof of this.

People have believed that the Vaikom Satyagraha took place to enter the temple. But it was to walk on the road outside the temple wall. When it is said that one shouldn't even walk outside the temple wall, what was the situation of the people at that time?

But what are we being preached and made to believe even today? - Temple Entry Proclamation! We have reached today's state by crossing so many such hurdles. Why achieve temple entry freedom after struggling so much? Could not worship a good deity. But even if worshipped, there is no use. We saw the state of Sree Rama, who is said to be the highest among our kings. This is a story from seventeen lakh years ago.

The history of one Chaturyuga is more than double this. We are so far away that we cannot take the true knowledge to know such a long history. But as far as we are concerned here, God has created an opportunity to say that we are not far from this knowledge. By removing all the hurdles faced by the past rishi lineages, bringing deva purification and pitru purification, and all such purifications, we have been brought to a karma where we can be born and claim liberation. This is our greatest victory and fortune. Being able to participate, do, and make others do this karma stands as our greatest glory. We have done so much work here to pass on this glory to children growing up as boys and girls.

This is the Guru Pooja we do at Santhigiri. People with knowledge, familiarity, and experience, and those who were judged not to know, see, or hear God's matters, are equally participants in this karma. Its glory stands so glorious that they cannot even imagine it. This karma is a great effort to overturn the path of karma that has come to us historically. This effort is the completion karma called Guru Pooja. It is not a tantri or someone who has studied, completed, and acquired karmic qualification who does this karma here. We see a history called fulfillment traditionally in our ancestors. We don't need to understand these histories without missing one. But coming here, we got God's permission to execute this. You must preserve it. Otherwise, it will become a great offense. To add this karmic qualification, which is fulfilled in this way, to you householders, a prayer of so long a time and a life just for it has been set aside. In this seventh Manvantara, twenty-eight Chaturyugas, and twenty-eight Kaliyugas in twenty-eight Chaturyugas, have passed. What karmas and dharmas are to be completed in this Kaliyuga? This Trimurti system has made us believe that such a Kali dharma is bad.

The karma we have fulfilled is not a matter achieved by any guide who came after Sree Krishna, or the prophetic religions that came with it, or the Hindu dharma, or any Sanatani. If we handle such a matter without respecting its greatness, it is an offense committed against God Himself. Understanding this perfectly, we must always be indebted to that will of Brahman that gave us the opportunity to resolve our karmic flaws. We are obliged to offer ourselves in that dharma. Regardless of the religion you belong to, you are receiving the completeness of the presence of Brahman, or the presence of Parabrahman. This is its greatness. Do not think this is merely a matter of a human. Being unable to do anything after getting the opportunity to achieve completeness is the biggest offense. If you understand this, you will get some knowledge that will make you understand on your own without asking how to act towards the dharma of the world.

God has provided the ways for pitrus, devas, and rishis to be born, get liberated, and achieve while remaining there in the realms they have gone and stood. Each of you must be vigilant about those ways. This is the path to eternity not only for you, but for everything that is to be born and grow traditionally hereafter, even down to an ant and a termite. This cannot be achieved without your karma and dharma. You must understand this completely.

Through you, God wants to bring a change to this traditional history. For that, each of you should work. Worship at the feet of the Guru. What does it mean? Arising within the principle, at the Guru's feet. Who is this Guru arising within the principle? Surrendering at the feet of such a Guru, one receives instructions suitable for liberation. 'Will give an instruction suitable for liberation, and birth will cease'

The greatest path shown by God for such a karmic destiny to reach you - that is the path of Santhigiri. This path will remove the errors that have existed in women until today. This path will remove the nonsense of men who have reached this far by playing around and acting irresponsibly. This path will remove the dirt of our life grown in a time when one could not distinguish south, north, east, and west. A path that will never again give room for such a karmic dosha (flaw). Through the prayers at Santhigiri, the destruction of the world itself will disappear forever.
Guruvani
June 2000

Today we have many types of worship methods. Those were told for us by the Mahatmas. But a situation has come where we are not able to understand it. In the name of worship, what we have is only a familiarity with what was practiced and performed in some era. If we get a new idea, we do not have the ability to absorb and act upon it. Something that does not give us the opportunity to act in that way is situated very secretly among us. It is over a long period that Chaturvarnya was completed. It is not known how this Chaturvarnya came about. This is what we call the Varnashrama system. It is said that this was brought in with the concept of Varna according to the times. But have we been told with certainty what those times are?

It is said to be Satyayugam, Tretayugam, Dvaparayugam, and Kaliyugam. It is also said 'Kali Shudrankal' (Kali belongs to the Shudra). If it is to be said 'Kali Shudrankal', there must be a reason for it. Otherwise, it would not be said so. We do not think about this because of our ignorance. There is evidence for it. Before the birth of Sri Krishna, Kamsa got to know about that birth. But he could not think about Sri Krishna's birth or give respect to that birth. What all did Kamsa, who got the birth of a king, do to prevent Krishna from being born? If such knowledge was given in a royal family, how would a Shudra take it? Shudra is not mentioned here to denote a caste. According to Varnashrama Dharma, all people born in the fourth quarter can only be born as Shudras. If this Shudra is to become a Dwija (twice-born) by karma, holding onto what should he perform the karma? What are those karmas?

No one has thought that good karma is not needed. But what is our knowledge regarding good karma? We would place a crude stone (Madan) and call it 'Lord'. In this state, who can perform good karma? When saying 'Kali Shudrankal', who are the Shudras? There are Shudras in all times. There are people of all four Varnas in all times. That is, the time for all Varnas to attain purity is the time of the Shudra. That is Kali. We have never thought about how to take up this purity until today. Many great souls were born in the Shudra clan after Sri Krishna. Although great souls were born in other clans, more Rishis, Sanyasis, Yogis, Karmis, Jnanis, and Bhaktas were born in the Shudra clan. The Shudra clan does not even know what they were able to achieve.

There was a prediction that Sri Krishna would be born; he was born. The rest were all killed. If this is the knowledge held by the upper Shudra, which Shudra can be expected to take up this karma? The Shudra class is one that does not even know why Sri Krishna was born. There are two hundred or three hundred castes within the Shudra class. Everyone says they are better than the other. When class hatred grew like this, Sikhs, Jains, and Buddhists came. Advaita was preached. Dvaita was preached. None of this could take up this karma. What should come next?
Seeker: There should be an idea that transcends all this.

Guru: Yes, but don't we need a familiarity with it? Three Mahatmas were born in Kerala. We could not recognize these three. Thousands of Mahatmas were born like this. We did not recognize any of them. Therefore, they could not achieve anything. What is the solution for this?
Seeker: People should think about spirituality.
Guru: It is not like that. They do think. They just don't have great knowledge,
that's all.

Seeker: There were some epoch-makers (Yugaprabhavan). At the same time they were born in this Kaliyuga by divine will, souls that had reached a certain stage in previous yugas also came in the system of deities (Devi-Deva). These Acharyas could not move to a state higher than that.
Guru: None of those who came were bad people. Thinking of them as bad is ignorance. We should think from the limits of our knowledge. Otherwise, the words will become worthless.
Seeker: There needs to be a divine leadership.
Guru: Yes. That is needed. What I am saying is that even though it was given, you could not take it.
Seeker: Epoch-making Gurus come and create their own structure. Following that, those who come later create various systems.
Guru: Yes.

Seeker: Through this structure, the instructions and principles of the Gurus disintegrate in many ways. Thus that blessedness, or that divinity, is lost. Those systems turn into various types of vested interests.

Guru: Yes. Like building a trap. This cannot be called worshiping God. You do not understand it this way. This basis is not there for the worship of God either. What exists now is not a divine basis, nor a prophetic system. It is just a Vedic religion meant for mere chanting.
Seeker: Each individual should get the light directly.

Guru: It won't be received like that. We have the merits of our birth, don't we? That merit should increase in our lineage. There is no other justification for this matter. What should be done to increase this aspect of merit? Will it happen if castes are separated? Will it happen if classes are separated? Isn't every child of yours - even the government administration - operating by separating like that? What should people do?
Seeker: People should have the eligibility for it.

Guru: Even if there is eligibility, it cannot be known. Now, aren't Jesus and the Prophet prophets? We have no way to take the words they have spoken. It is celebrated that Sri Shankara preached Advaita. Does saying the meaning of the word mean that God will come?
Seeker: Only a lineage with God-realization can know this.

Guru: Yes. That is correct. But we don't have such a lineage. Is it enough to just preach for that? What could you do for it? Even if it is done and placed in front of you, you won't be able to take it.
Seeker: That requires sacrifice. We are unable to do it because of our inability.
Guru: Such inability has happened to you. Not that you are bad people. Your ability is lying at the bottom. If it is brought to light, you will have everything. I have done the work for that here.
Guruvani
July 2000

How do these Yugas change? Three Yugas have passed. Satyayugam, Tretayugam, Dvaparayugam. In Satyayugam, everything will be equal as truth for all of us. Tretayugam came. We did not get back the karma of that Tretayugam. The karma of Satyayugam is not for Tretayugam. The karma of Tretayugam is not for the Dvaparayugam that followed. In Kaliyugam, which is the fourth quarter of a Chaturyugam, there should be a completion for all these three. The reason we did not get back the karma of these Yugas is because we do not know what all karmas have happened, and the divine will that gave the opportunity to fulfill this Yugadharma, which was divided into four as Karmi, Yogi, Bhakta, and Jnani. The Jnanis see this from the origin. This is to be completed again in the Dvaparayugam. That Yugadharma was not fulfilled and taken up. Tretayugam, Dvaparayugam - in these two Yugas, those who did not seek salvation in Satyayugam and who were not Jnanis were sent as Gurus or Devas. This is the time for this Deva and Devi. Why are they given time like that? When man becomes a Deva and the completion of the Deva comes, then it is the departure of the Jnani. A Tyagi (renunciate) or a perfect Sanyasi should be in accordance with the departure of the Jnani. This is the dharma of Kali. It is due to a flaw caused by a Brahma curse that no one becomes a Jnani. The reason for that is the ignorance that came through the four dictums like 'Aham Brahmasmi' and later the Panchamahavakyas.

The practical aspect according to this Yugadharma comes through the Rishis. Although the Rishis are not under anyone, when the time of the Deva changes, they do not wish to go beyond it. The Devas keep the Rishis as their clan gurus (Kulaguru). The kings keep them as their clan gurus. While advising the kings, they try not to let them go from under the Deva. That is why this Ashvamedha Yaga is conducted. When talking about Sita, stories were made up that Sita was found by plowing. Thus, making father Janaka the foster father of Sita is because the story was covered up. Without knowing the meaning of Yugadharma in a way suitable for this, the Brahmin became a Tantri. He became a Tantri and also an authority of Yugadharmas. How far will this Tantri reach?

Do not believe that this Tantric karma is non-existent. It is for all three times. The third time was made into a Jnani. That is Kali. At the end of Kali, it is changing to Satyayugam. The calamity that the Yugadharma did not take place in that way is due to the Brahma curse. This has crossed twenty-five Chaturyugas. Before the completion of the third Chaturyugam of Vaivasvata Manu and the start of the next Satyayugam, a Rishi named Satyatranan came. Satyatranan is a person in the lineage under this Manu. It is this Rishi who made a mistake. The Adiguru of the Yugadharma is the Adiguru of the fourth Chaturyugam. So he did not misunderstand. When he looked at where and how his predecessors had operated, he saw that there was no thought that was not his own. Then he looked at the visionary aspect. It's not there either. The entire Deva aspect, which has been turned and twisted in many ways as realization, was shared by those who shared realization in that way. When he looked like this, he couldn't see any karma without his own karma. Because he was a scholar, a worthy person, and a Yugapurusha on this path, he applied the Chathurvakyas. No story outside of this has come to date. Then some Gurus among the Jnanis wished to tell the truth here and there. But, when it came to three traditions—Vaishnavas in the Vaishnava tradition, Shaivas in the Shaiva tradition, and Shakteyas in the Shaktheya tradition—the Vaishnava was made a person of Satyayugam. There was no one to cross over the Deva and go beyond. When operating this way, Jivatmas who were qualified to become even Brahmarakshass could not pass through. Numerous Yugadharmas themselves blocked them. Along that path, they took the name of Yogi and remained in the Kalpaseva tradition and in the fortress of Siddhi networks completed using various Rasamanis. This is the Mulika Siddhanta (herb theory) of Bogar Ezhayiram. This is also what Agasthyar's Pantheerayiram says. The theories converted into Agasthyar's kashayams, powder medicines, and lehyams, and Bogar's alchemy application, rasamani, sthambanamani, gounamani, and such various manis had to be written and left here. Then the Tantrasamucchaya called karma was covered up here. They aptly named it Tantra. The Vedas and Itihasas themselves had to be forged so that they would never deviate from this Tantric aspect. Thus, when coming along that path, it is seen that it stood without a way to cross it until the time of Buddha.

But, it is not the Buddha we see today. This is what 'Yatra Yogeshwarah Krishna' says. Therefore, a value judgment had to come stating that the Buddha we see today has no karma. It is true. A Jnani has no karma. If dharma is to be practiced and contained, it can only be done through karma. There is no rule that a Jnani must do such karma. Then, operating without distinguishing karma, dharma, charity, and merit, the Yugadharmas themselves went wrong. When it came to that path, it became a period where no one could enter Satyayugam. It became impossible to know where to fit the Chaturvarnya of Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra belonging to these four classes according to the Yugadharma. This is the very same Brahma curse mentioned earlier. The literate ones who have come to date cannot say this matter. That is the language created by refining (Sanskrit). Along that path, they wrote, preserved, and studied word formations. Starting from Sriramodantham to 'Amara Nirjara Deva', it was taken and completed in Amarakosham. As they kept saying it, these three groups reached the Trimurthi state of Shakteyam, Shaivam, and Vaishnavam. This Trimurthi state is the item that has been mixed and studied this way, rising up as Tantric and Mantric, and completed in Tantric culture.

It has been stated that Kali is destruction. A path approaching that Kali was stopped by this Tantric culture. Without completing Kalidharma, one can never enter Satyayugam. This is a true aspect of it. The Trimurthi state was operated and contained over ten Chaturyugas. Remaining without doing anything, and when another three Chaturyugas were added, thirteen Chaturyugas were completed. Then, what has been going on since the fourteenth Chaturyugam is the imitation of the aforementioned Tantric culture. Thus, while changing everything into Deva and Devi, the Panchabhoothas (five elements) themselves became Deva and Devi. The Devas and Rishis seeing its recurrence gave the name of Deva to the Panchabhoothas. Thus, dividing from Bhoothaganam to Nakshatraganam, the Tantric culture was completed. It was stopped and completed in Mahavishnu. Vaishnava, Shaiva, and Shaktheya also completed the same. Then these three groups forged Vedantic words and letters for all that as Maya and Mahamaya. Even ghosts and ghouls were converted into Devas. They got stuck in a way not knowing what Rishi groups were. They fell into a karmic dosha where it couldn't be said what was beyond the Nakshatraganam. This karmic dosha became ungraspable by anyone. After that, it became impossible to repeat the three periods that came. These three Yugas also became something no one could study and grasp.

Satyayugam, Tretayugam, Dvaparayugam, Kaliyugam. This fourth, Kali, is the path of Jnana. It became impossible for us to get this from a Rishi. Jnanis do not reach there at all. It is Sri Krishna who was seen completing it in some way. The story of sixteen thousand and eight women was forged for such a Sri Krishna. Then they were said to be great women comparable to Rishis. And then they were given the position of Guru.

The beginning of Jnana is the part that is neither male nor female. Aside from standing at that beginning, it has not moved an inch forward. That is why Maharshis added the stream of light beyond these four Vedas. That is why it was written 'Aaseedagre Asathe Vedam'. Light originated from the beginning. Thus everyone has spoken about the light-color of the Upanishads. We should look at what is said in the Narayanopanishad. In this Narayanopanishad, Devibhagavatam, and subsequently, or in the Shaiva Purana in the Shaiva tradition, it has been covered up like this. Narayana Guru himself has said this matter in many places. But he has not crossed over. It is not a fault. No one has been able to grasp till today that fulfilling the path of dharma using the path of karma that has recurred is the dharma of Kali, due to this Brahma curse. This is the shortcoming today. What can we do if both scholars and laymen are our parents.

The time has become Kali - the expression of sorrow along this path remained just like a Smarthavicharam (trial). This is the reason for this; the true reason. What is the proof for this? That error that occurred in Kalpathi in Palakkad has gripped you. That is where I have arrived, standing as a medium. There is still the old habit of conducting Smarthavicharam through the erroneous path of the Brahmin woman. Therefore, whether it is a mother, daughter, wife, or sister, they fall and decay in the Triguna determination. Without ever moving forward from this position, calling out like beggars calling 'Appa Amma Mahamaye', and joining it with Bhagavan, it became Bhagavan's Mahamaya. The dominance of Maya matured and has reached up to Calcutta Kali. It won't step out of Mahamaya. Instead, if it is said Brahma-Vishnu-Maheshwaras, it is enough for them to carefully observe the sign seen in Suchindram. Because Anasuya had the penance power of Sage Atri, they became little children. When scholars added and wrote it, they wrote that it was Bhagavan's Mahamaya. Completing everything by writing Mahamaya is a diversion from this Trimurthi state. From there, women's maternal love is left behind, and it has become part of Smarthavicharam. Our thought is on how to correct them. The people involved in this - our mother, our sister, our daughter, our wife - all have dissolved and sunk here. Because it was not understood that the karmic capacity that could not be corrected till today was transferred and reached over ten Chaturyugas, all these causes had to be twisted like this. We could not realize the magnitude of the word Chaturyugam. As a result of catching this karmic dosha that stands beyond thought, the human race, which did not even get an opportunity to think and complete the maxim 'Matha Pitha Guru Daivam', went back to the path where origin started, and the ice melted away due to the power of solar heat, concentrating and becoming as cold as a mountain. This is a calamity not understood by the whole human world. This stopped from the part that envisions the perfection of realization. That is why the Sukta Vedas given at the beginning and end of our Upanishadic Suktas, at the head and tail of the Shanti Patha. This is why in Tantrasamucchaya, in the nature of Tantric completion, it is completed as Sahanaavavatu Sahanau Bhunaktu Sahaveeryam Karavaavahai. At its beginning and end, it is established as Poornamada Poornamidam Poornaad Poornamudachyate Poornasya Poornamaadaaya Poornamevaavashishyate.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanti Edition 2000
Guru Margam is the formula for goodness

On what path has your karma brought you and stopped you? You have envisioned and acted to bring forces that fight against God. The path of Dharma has created hymns of denials that have never been built. Everything is a mischief that shows denial completely. As long as you keep this vile behavior, it is destruction for you. You are never going to escape from this.

The book knowledge divided into Savarna and Avarna is the Vedic chanting of karmic dosha. You do something. If asked what it is and for what, do you know how to say? What will you, who have suffered this fate, earn as a result of karma? You are never going to become anything.

I am not speaking by making you, your tradition, or me good or bad. It is the pain of experiencing and knowing the flawed aspect of a great old habit. It is a pain if you do not understand what that flawed aspect is. If you do not understand what that flawed aspect is, it will become a violence committed against your generations. This violence is happening in all houses called big houses. I am saying this keeping the familiarity of what I have directly seen.

You should not do or propagate any karma that is capable of destroying dharma by realizing ego through humility. This is my word to any children who feel love towards God. They will understand my pain well.

Everyone is talking about a synthesis of ideas. With what should the synthesis of ideas be conducted? How can a synthesis of ideas be conducted while keeping the contradictions and flaws in the tradition of each idea in their respective states? Each class is an oracle devoid of dharma, without karma, overflowing with vile acts. If they desire to win at the feet of the Swami, how will they win? Desiring so itself is unjust.

This time is Kali. Kalikalam will not stand watching this injustice. What needs to be washed away will be washed away. Everything that needs to happen due to drought will happen. If it is seen that you do not follow the justice of Kali, it will completely destroy you. You should not assume that karma is these chaotic arguments. Is this chaos what you are trying to pass on to your children as well? Is this your complete social goal? If the lineage is taught to come to the old tradition, it will be digging up the foundation of their sense of dharma and karmic ability.

Mahatmaji spoke of Ramarajya. What is the state of that organization today? In the karma where love, respect, and humility should be taken by including them in dharma, you are nobody; in that place, standing in a negative mischief, you fight and win. You are moving forward by transferring this mischief to generations and destroying them. This situation is my pain. A karmic destiny that does not think about what life is has occurred even among Sanyasis. This is not the fault of those who came today, yesterday, or those who will come tomorrow. It is the familiarity with a karma that went astray on the side of Sanyasa itself. Therefore, bringing them under religion, they have been made objects of ridicule. The karma of a Sanyasi has lost its position and respect. It is the result of an intellect that operated in some era. We should see from where and in which era that intellect started operating. This should be operated while convincing the people. There should also be a solution for that. That should also happen according to the law. It should be provisioned in the constitution. Thus, a permanent state should be brought about in the causes and effects.

Those who speak a certain kind of socialism will incite the government into some karmic actions harmful to the public interest. Assuming that such things will happen, what we need is a sense of dharma that overcomes all that. We need to move forward after taking root in that dharma. Emphasis should be given to a karma keeping the goodness of the people at the forefront. There is no need to look at right and wrong there.

The total knowledge of the world is that Kali is destruction. When that knowledge came, the knowledge of the home, the land, and the country became like that. We could not respect any of the Mahatmas who have come to date and bring them into karma. An evidence for that is the end of Sri Rama. It is said that Sri Rama stepped into the river and attained Jalasamadhi. We did not inquire what was the reason if he had to attain Jalasamadhi like that. How many Mahatmas have come in the two Yugas after that? We do not know what their sad story is. The path the Puranas and Itihasas turned and brought the stories of the Mahatmas, we also traveled on that same path. Puranas repeatedly spoke of three times (Yugas). They did not say what the dharma of Kali is. They said the dharma of Kali is with the Shudra.

What is the meaning of Shudra? In the karma practiced as four Varnas, the Shudra absolutely stands in the dharma eligible for Jnana. But what have the people belonging to the Shudra Varna, who constitute about eighty-four percent in India, done?

There are histories of many Gurus who came isolated and in groups of Yoga, Karma, Bhakti, and Jnana in India. Yet, we stand like strangers, caught in a moral dilemma not knowing which is Karma and which is Jnana. We do not have the knowledge to ever correct it. Gurus are those who came seeing and knowing all this. But pointing out their ideas, we talk about Communism, Socialism, etc. Getting their karma which is akin to Vijnana (making it seem like special Jnana), we do not wish to come into Jnana through that karma. Not even a single child was with them to behave according to the desire of the Gurus. Therefore, recognizing the Yugadharma, it was not possible to operate and reach a stage to retrieve the dharma of Kali. Therefore, it was established that Kali is destruction. In reality, Kali is not destruction. Those who wrote and established it like this sowed destruction to the world.

Transfer the Jnana that has come mixed among Brahmin, Kshatriya, and Vaishya in three periods (Krita, Treta, Dvapara Yugas) to the Shudra. This is what must be reached in the fourth quarter. But what stands bewildered in front of us is a karmic capacity not knowing what to do in the fourth quarter. This is the plight that has come because of not knowing the dharma of the time. However, some have said in some places a few words that Kali is indeed good among the times. We did not accept these words of the Mahatmas. Instead, some other contradictory justifications have been stated.

When speaking of Sanyasis, most of the people assume that they are mere mendicants, or beggars. These are great flaws they bring upon themselves. Sanyasis are neither beggars nor mendicants. It is said referring to Jnanis that he is a Siddha. Siddhi is not Jnana; neither is Siddhi the complete form of Sanyasa. Siddhi is a method of magical illusions (Mayajala) that worships each Deva and Devi, shows some of their respective praises, and bewilders and convinces the people.

Who is a Sanyasi? Passing through so many eras like Satyayugam, Tretayugam, Dvaparayugam, Kaliyugam, the one who fulfills and carries forward the dharma of Kali through the path of Jnana is a Sanyasi. When such a great person is born and comes among the people, most of the ascetic guises seen today are the rest of what was operated out of intense greed with the thought that no one should be greater than me, unable to recognize it. This mistake has not come through the ignorance of just one caste or one religion. Those belonging to all castes and all religions have fallen into the pit of this mistake. Thus, we are completely ignorant in the part of knowledge called Guru.

Guru is not one who seeks Jnana after being born. Guru is the one who operates and settles seeing what the evolutionary action of life has been over many eras. The world has no knowledge about such a Guru. What is the ignorance that has happened to India, apart from Sri Krishna in the last five thousand years, no other individual - whether a scholar or a layman - has said. Some wished to say this. They couldn't. Because some family members who stood with them and the retinue who stood along with that became karmic culprits who desired that others should not rise. The people, whether belonging to that lineage or not, have not understood this. These Gurus did not have a disciple - as a Sanyasi and a Grihasthashrami - or a follower to bring the karma, which was operated and settled with limitless suffering, to fruition. It cannot be said that it is their fault either. Because the human race entirely is the remnant of the greatest erroneous familiarity that has crossed twenty-five Chaturyugas. Ordinary contemporaries cannot be blamed for that. Therefore, no one knows how to correct this mistake and where to start that correction.

If someone comes and shows a Siddhi or a miraculous act, the people have the knowledge and tendency to see it as the greatest. A Jnani should never show Siddhi. Without getting a Sanyasi who does not show Siddhi, the prayer and character of the people will not become right. Saying everything is Bhagavan's Maya and sinking into it, how will prayer align with the times? How will character purity occur?

The knowledge of Sri Krishna is the knowledge of the Gita. How should that knowledge be copied into life? Even if one studies or recites the refined Hindu Puranas and Itihasas, the essence of the Gita's knowledge cannot be grasped. Because the Veda of Kali could not be retrieved from the four Vedas, Kali became a destruction. It is placed that the four Vedas should be operated and completed in one Chaturyugam. The length of one Chaturyugam is twelve thousand divine years. One divine year is three hundred and sixty human years. How can a Chaturyugam of such length be completed with refined Vedas, Puranas, and Itihasas? Can the rich, a scholar, or one who has studied and gained scientific sense fulfill the Kalidharma? It's not possible. This is the biggest blunder that happened to India. If this is to be corrected, it should be seen at least from the time of Sri Rama. Not only that, the position where Sri Krishna stands must also be understood.

What we have done is mocking Sri Krishna as we know him. This has been executed by playing and making others play Krishnaleela, making it ugly, decorating it into Kathakali, spoiling it, and explaining that spoiled version. This is a great error stuck with the world. No Purana, no Itihasa, and no history will correct this error for you. This is an experiential truth I have understood. I am not saying this by witnessing another knowledge.

There was a time when it was assumed that if the Trimurthis appeared, everything was achieved. But rather than Trimurthis, seeing what Shaiva, Shaktheya, and Vaishnava karmas are and how they came, we must be able to know and let know what the action of Jnana that came from the face of Brahma is. To let that be known, if a person came, he was not allowed to live. For example, Dayananda Saraswati. At least some people with knowledge know what he has done. Born in a Brahmin clan, this great man fought his whole life questioning this mistake. In Tamil Nadu, denying this same mistake, many Padalgal (songs) came into existence. Among that, a doctrine saying One Caste, One Clan, One God has also come into history.

There is a history that the four states of South India were ruled by kings belonging to the Shudra class - Pandyan, Cholan, and Cheraman Perumal. Without seeing any of this, singing the praises of Shiva, they repeated the mistake that occurred in the Yugantaras (transition of Yugas) there. Without understanding in which era Shiva was a reincarnated deity, by repeatedly talking and raising it to Kailash, in what all ways have they made it? In the same way, on the Shaktheya path, the karma danced and decorated up to Calcutta Kali, and the favorite deity of the Mysore King, Chamundeshwari, were brought in. Thus, all kings have made a blunder. The Maharaja of Travancore has also made this very blunder. Why was this karma given in the hands of these kings? What were they supposed to do? Instead of telling them that the path of the Shudra is towards Jnana, they imparted barbarism, ignorance, and lovelessness. And then, making humans into so many castes, they beat them and kept them afar. Bringing refined language into the temple premises, they built Koothambalams, Pattambalams, and Oottupuras, and brought karmic dosha among the people. What path do the people have to correct and recognize this karmic dosha? Even the Mahatmas who came by divine will could not correct this.

Sanyasa is not something gathered up in some way. It is a great effort through sacrifice. Making an effort through Yugantaras, fulfilling the Yugadharmas in whatever ways they exist, and becoming the authority of all Yugas, fulfilling the dharma of the time of liberation is Sanyasa. Guru is the one who corrects the Yugantara dharma, seeing the dharma that reaches up to the constellations, without rejecting even an atom, let alone a devil that has come till date, giving each its rightful place.

This knowledge is not completed in the Hindu Puranas. In the Hindu Puranas, it is just hinted here and there and left somewhere. According to the Trimurthi system, destruction came to Kali. Increasing more and more over many eras, this mistake was completed. First, the ignorance that has been imparted with the notion that a Sanyasi means one who wants nothing, walks along the road, a mere beggar, or a mendicant.

Guru is Sakaladharmatma; we should see the Guru in this magnitude. Proclaiming to the world through his own disciple the truth that he is the seat of all dharma - this is the characteristic of a Guru. Till today, no Mahatma has been allowed to grow to the extent of being proclaimed as Guru Sakaladharmatma. Not only the Acharyas belonging to the Hindu religion, but also those from other religions were not allowed. Each religion is divided into so many sects and churches. They have become a terrible fight with each other. In India, it lies mixed up so much that it is impossible to recognize what Sanathana is. No matter how much the Shaiva, Shaktheya, and Vaishnava arguments increase, this mix-up is not going to change.

The Shudra class, which stands divided into eighty-four castes in India, is supposed to become various faces of Jnana in Kali. In that place, making them completely ignorant, bringing in story and play, it has been completed.

Kali is the time permitted by God to bring the entire human race to theoretical knowledge and the path of Jnana. Whatever is operated and taken by the father, mother, and children in a family should come through the Jnana acquired from the Guru. What needs to be acquired through that Jnana is the knowledge of what happened in the past Chaturyugas, and in what nature the crores of Mahatmas who happened to be like that stand merged in the atmosphere. It is said there are only twenty-seven Nakshatras (stars). Then how did crores of stars come? It is about the causes and effects of this that one must know on the path of Jnana. If the foolishness served instead of Jnana is that if that great man opens his eyes without knowing what is good and bad possessing karmic capability in this atmosphere, it will be burnt to ashes, what good can they do for the world? They are nothing on the side of karma and dharma, and are not going to become anything either.

Today's government is a great injustice where the subtlety of ignorance has grown and arrived. Not only that, they are open babblers of vile karma. Nothing can be done other than this political chaos perishing. If the service duty meant to impart human goodness is given into the hands of messed-up generations, they will only serve and preserve destruction here. Who can remove this karmic dosha? For whom is this government that stands dharma-fied, serving and experiencing injustice? Is this for the destruction of the clan, for the destruction of the progressive karma they speak of, or to destroy the world itself? Anyway, the formula of goodness is not at all in this. So what do we need?

One should separate and know the goodness of everything with love. Then realizing it, one must reach the path of Mangalodayam that provides fortune and liberation. That is Gurumargam. That is God's path.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanti Edition 2000
The Source of Truth

When seeking an understanding, one should at least know the history of a past Chaturyugam. So many Mahatmas came. So many ideological traits came. So many Puranas were composed. The truth in history cannot be known from anything. The majority of people in the world do not know the historical truth.

First realize the historical truth. Action after that. Otherwise the mission--even if it is a mission of the Mahatmas--cannot be fulfilled. Mahatmaji was the greatest Tyagi in modern India. He held fast to the name of Rama and the concept of Ramarajya. Ramarajya and Tretayugam have become obsolete by Yugadharma. Because he went after that worship, Gandhiji's mission was not fulfilled. Even being such a great Tyagi, India could not respect or obey his words.

We have not come with the oldness of one or two births. There is the oldness of many lifetimes. Do our actions receive divine mercy suitable for this oldness? As a human being, this is a subject that deserves the most thought. To get God's mercy, one must act truly, lovingly, and with respect.

We learn and practice truth, dharma, mercy, and compassion from the path our parents and other ancestors went. Such a system was going on then. But what is happening today is not the system that happened then. Today the world is not running in this method either. It is in another method. We must see that method directly. This is a time when today's people, especially children, can see it. Because we are the children of Kali. Since we are children who have come in Kali, we can see whatever we want and achieve whatever we want. But we need to have a knowledge regarding Kali. Otherwise, we will not be able to follow that historical truth.

The true aspect of history is situated far beyond the status of a Deva. Crores and crores of Devas and Devis, so many statuses. Humans who worshipped this have also got those statuses. It is not easy to cross all this and go beyond to see the truth. But even if there is a little hardship, it is possible in these times. How? Devas, Devis, Rishis, Sanyasis, Jnanis, and Bhaktas will come before us, or we can realize them, they say. However, the ancestors could not do this. Why?

Have the fortune to reach the Guru lineage. Through thoughts about the Guru or with the help of the Guru, we get the fortune for these Devas, Devis, and Mahatmas to come before us. When this comes before us, the Guru shows us all their untruth and truth. And then the Guru makes the truth true and gives it to us. Just as we see the truth, we will also see the untruth. It has joined them as a result of the karmic dosha committed in some past lives. This karmic dosha has affected us too. Because we have worshipped it. We must have such an understanding. From this understanding, we have to rise higher and higher to reach a level.

The believers in Santhigiri, both young children and adults, are able to see and grasp this way. That is because of their contact with the Guru. Not only that, there is also some goodness behind this. In dream or in wakefulness, they are seeing these Devas, Devis, Rishis, and many other similar things. No one should say this doesn't exist. All this exists. One can see all this keeping the Guru as a witness. Our faith, love, respect, and all the truths and untruths we see should be given to the Guru. That is, offered to the Guru. We are entrusting it to the Guru in order to get what we deserve, and to reach the level we deserve.

What is seen with the presence of the Guru is the truth. We might see many things even without the presence of the Guru--skies, spheres, and many other huge things like that. If it is without the Guru's presence, it is not reality, it is Maya. It is the temptation of some subtle forces. It is mesmerizing. There are many stories that mesmerize us like this. No goodness of any kind is going to come to us by reading or hearing those stories. We must see this to have goodness. Seeing is not that easy. For that, small services should be done in the Guru Sankalpa (concept of the Guru). Each small service will provide the goodness of each experience. Even Mahatmas have respected that service. Sri Krishna in his childhood has done service in the ashram of Sage Sandipani. Bringing collected firewood from the forest, drawing water, what all services! One day he wandered in the forest not knowing the way. Rain also came. What to do? Stories of suffering like this exist in the Sri Krishna Charithra itself.

These are all stories of that time. Today's time is not that. Today's ashram nature is not that either. Service should be done according to today's ashram nature. Thus we should have a sense of dharma to see, know, act, and take it. Then we will have a perspective different from the stories we learned from the Puranas and Itihasas. Through those experiences, our soul will gain strength and become powerful. When the soul becomes powerful like that, many fulfillments will come in life. Then the imagination that only oneself and the Guru exist will come. This is a very high state. The time ordained to reach such a state is Kali. It is a very great fortune to have the opportunity to be born with such a Guru in such a time. If we preserve this fortune, within three generations, all the ignorance seen in the world today will change, and a situation will arise where the government itself teaches what love and truth are. That is, it is going to happen when our generation grows up, its next generation grows up, and its next generation grows up. Do not assume that we have seen all this and everything is fine now. But after seeing all this and going, coming back again will be in this state. The reason for having such a fortune coming is because of seeing the Guru.

This is the way to receive God's mercy and love. Consider the love and respect you show to your father, mother, neighbors, and fellow beings as the love and respect shown to God. Do not think of it merely as something shown to humans. We are giving to fellow humans the love that God gave us. Then they will return that very same love. There is something that God directly pours into our life. It is none of this. That is something else.

How do we practice this tradition of love? Love humans just as you love God. When loving humans, do not consider caste, religion, race, high, or low. However, one must consider Dharma. That Dharma can be learned from the Guru over time.

When loving humans, a sage-like tolerance is required. One must step away from all feelings of hatred. No matter what injustice or harm fellow beings do to us, without thinking that they shouldn't have done this to me, one should pray, "Oh God, please give them good sense!" One must pray with a pained heart, "Father, are they showing their might by doing unwanted things in this nature? Please don't let them feel like doing this." The ashram should be seen as a place where one side of tolerance is practiced like this. Once that is done, there will be a realization that this itself is not enough. Then it is that knowledge which guides us. In this way, the knowledge, experience, and tradition of crores of people are growing. Then all the shortcomings and all the pains of life that have existed until today will change, and a truthful life can be offered to the world. This is the blessedness we must acquire through the ashram experience. Such recitation of the Vedas of life is the karma we must perform for the realization of historical truth.

We have heard about many ashrams like Kanvashram, Vashisthashram, and Vishwamitrashram. It is Vishwamitra. The sage who is a friend of the universe (Vishwam). This is not just storytelling. To be a friend of the universe, a human must become so great. Each of us can become owners of such great life. Anyone born in any caste, religion, or race, man or woman, small or great, can become that. It only requires determination and a sense of duty.

The ashram is the place that nurtures this habit of thinking. History shows no other model of an ashram in the world other than Santhigiri. For the children growing up in Santhigiri, how much truth is contained in the position of Devan; how much truth is in the position of a Sage (Rishi); how much truth is in the positions of Sanyasi and Jnani; what levels of truth exist in a devotee and a prophet—all this is seen in experience. If a soul has even a small ancestral merit, it is experienced in the presence of the Guru. A culture blended with the courage, love, respect, and humility to remove whatever destruction there is in the world is what is acquired from Santhigiri. For that, one only needs the practice of safeguarding the Guru's word as Dharma without abandoning it.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition 2000
Where the Light of Knowledge and the Sound of Pranava Reside

The history of the world so far is so long that no one can completely narrate or convince others of it. How many crores of years has this history existed, how many crores of great souls' lives stand accumulated before us—we cannot calculate any of this. Whether these great souls came for us or for themselves, no one needs to doubt that they came to execute the divine will (Brahmanischayam). But one thing is certain. They all create the impression of having fallen into a deep pit. This predicament has been happening for the past twenty-five Chaturyugas.

The history of six Manvantaras and twenty-eight Chaturyugas is before us. Among them, the Trimurti system that depicted Chaturmukhan, or Nanmukhan, using twenty-two Chaturyugas also exists. But the history seen in it is one where Nanmukhan's history is told and that face of knowledge (Jnanamukham) stops midway. No one says where the face of knowledge went. The Puranas mention the account of Chaturmukhan. In the Trimurti system, this face of knowledge has been attached to the three faces of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. It is said that the cause of the creation of the world is the concept (Sankalpam) of the Saptarishis. In this concept of the Saptarishis, what is the blueprint of a solar system?

How many great men and women have worked hard to highlight the two sides, external and internal, of the penance (Tapovritti) of the theoreticians, or the class of ascetics or sages, who have come in the world so far! The story of their life sacrifice is the longest. This is what the Hindu religion, or the prophetic religions formed by the concept of God, should highlight.

When looking at the history available across different periods and subjects, it is seen that a mistake occurred somewhere. The eminent scholars here are the ones who form formulas using words and alphabets based on this mistake. The early texts in this category are the early forms of Sanskrit, ranging from Shabdarupavali to Amarakosha. The Trimurti system is the tradition brought in to sustain this. Through that path or system, the arranged spiritual and material aspects, and the system of ascetics and sages drawn combining all these, and their power of penance—even if explained together, one cannot describe where that sound went, which was in the original concept of Manu, or in the original concept of the Saptarishis. The scholars have only reinforced this unfortunate situation.

Charakan, Sushrutan, Dhanvantari, and then Ravana who wrote Arkaprakasha—all the types of medical sciences that existed from their times have become slightly stronger later. It is seen that Siddha and Ayurveda, which were brought up to the application of Rasavataka by Agasthyar's 12000 and Bhogar's 7000, became very prominent from ancient times. It is imagined that the great souls who discovered the medicinal values sprouted and grown in nature—preserved for the protection of the body and to prevent untimely death of life—stood under each plant and thought about what it was, and a light told them, "I can be used for this purpose." Arkaprakasha, Agasthyar 12000, Bhogar 7000, and all others in the original lineage are formed through such imagination. Modern science is also what has come to be practiced in various ways by various people. Hahnemann, who discovered Homeopathy, also applied and experienced it in the same way. Looking at it that way, everything has grown to an extent where nothing can be set aside. The only difference is that modern medical science and Homeopathy do not state the evolutionary formula of life through penance. Without using the five senses, the five sheaths, and the five elements, they formulated another method and formulated speed. When talking about high speed, they don't have time to think about the three Gunas, the five elements, or the five senses. Therefore, they couldn't know about the miseries of life. They didn't travel that path. That is not a flaw. The correction from their own principles will be enough for them. That is why the concept of God corrected it in another way. It must be thought that since an original karma completing both the spiritual and material aspects lies in India, they tried to complete only the material aspect.

Nuclear scientists can only see this by standing above. That expertise is what the biologists in the Middle East and India discovered. To explain it more broadly, Bharadwaja, who discovered aeronautics, is an Indian and a contemporary of Ravana. Due to his high speed, he denied the Guru and acted without knowing the wheel of time (Kalachakra).

The wheel of time is this: Satyayuga, Tretayuga, Dwaparayuga, and Kaliyuga. He failed to know how to divide this wheel of time. It is a lack of wisdom similar to the lack of wisdom in modern science that discovered long-range missiles. All the intellect that desired to travel at such high speed became like possessing a barbaric nature. That is why we can see the full form of barbaric rule ready to fight the whole world, with science and times reaching a dead end and causing intellectual delusion, so that future scientists or realists cannot move forward. It is because life was not valued that the ups and downs of the wheel of time could not be recorded. Modern scientists also had the misfortune of discovering something else and claiming that something else exists. The acceptance of the ancient system of medicine discovered to sustain life according to Indian philosophy is evidence for this.

When Western medical science failed to respect the karma course of life, it reached the argument that there is no birth. However, they respect plant species and medicinal herbs. They practice herbal medicine. Some Indian ascetics who accepted Vedanta and the Advaita religion hold a perspective in the field of knowledge that is different from all this. It is by following the Advaita argument that the practitioners of magical illusions (Siddhijala) perform sky travel and the alchemical applications of Gamanamani and Stambhanamani. Bhogar went a bit further from this. It was Bhogar who formulated the Navapashanas. The idol of Subramanya in Palani, described as a deity sitting in the shade by the stone, is made of Navapashanas. That idol sits looking towards Kerala. It is said that this is why Keralites show so much interest in Palani. Subramanya was consecrated there due to the interest of his own Guru, Bhogar. Praising this consecration, Sree Narayana Guru said,
Compassionately turning to the south, by the stone,
May the deity who sat in the shade protect us.

As the Purana writers and artists who were devotees of Subramanya gathered, they also added the story that Subramanya pinched off one of the heads of Nanmukhan. Another set of people wrote it differently. That is, the meaning of 'Omkara' was asked of these three faces. Nobody knew the meaning. Then they said the fourth face is not there. For that, it is written that Subramanya pinched off one head of the four-faced Brahma.

This is the logic of the Purana creators. This logic was also applied in writing the Ramayana. They gave meaning to it as 'Ra Mayanam' and taught it to the ignorant Shudra class. Sree Sankara also completed this based on the Chaturvakyas. Along with that, some stories were also written to make it appear that Sree Sankara created castes. One of those stories is that Parvathi lay on the path as an outcaste woman (Parachi). Sree Sankara shouted "Hoy" and asked the Parachi to step aside.
