Then the Parachi asked, "Son, if you, who have self-knowledge, are polluted, what will others do?" This was written by one Sankara. When another Sankara came, he wrote Soundarya Lahari. By pouring the full form of beauty into it, Parvathi became a young woman.

Like this, various Sankaracharyas came and wrote hymns like Soundarya Lahari, Shyamala Dandakam, Kali Nadakam, and the Kundalini Stotram. Thus, the essence of Vedanta that came and went, and the Vedantic pomp of showing magical illusions, were completed. Spiritualists went after this Yoga Shastra filled with miracles and got lost. This is how the Yoga paths like Rajayoga and Chandrikayoga originated. It was taught to the poor Shudra as the miracle of miracles. Running after such miraculous powers, Shaiva and Vaishnava devotees wrote many beauties, reaching a state where neither Dwaita nor Advaita exists.

Without showing the way to the beginning of meditation where the actions of the mind cease, Rajayoga, Chandrikayoga, Hamsayoga, Hathayoga, and many such Yogas were written standing similar to the forms and names of the Purana creators. All the Yoga practitioners who followed this, without getting liberation for their souls, are jumping up in various ways and burning up just like the sun burns standing where it is. This is all they achieved through this Yoga practice.

There is a group wandering without being caught in any of this, not reaching anywhere. They are the ones sharing roles as Mantramurthi, Yantramurthi, Yogeeshwara, and Brahmarakshass. By worshipping these, some face danger. The Madan, Nadan, and Nadeshan tantric practices of the sorcerer complete this. As each of these was filled along this path, Dwaita and Advaita ceased to exist. Not only that, all those who completed the Mayavada by saying it exists and it doesn't, and felt satisfied, ended up in danger.

Thus they brought about a disorder devoid of time and the determination of time. That position was taken over by magical powers and sleight of hand. That is how the state of being unable to distinguish between the spiritual and the material came to be. Those who show these magical practices are the ones who show the anxiety that the greatest God resides in them. This has no connection with true knowledge. These are all thorny fences where knowledge reaches a dead end. The enthusiasts of Vedanta are getting destroyed playing this magic. This has happened to all religions. It has happened to all classes. This is the affliction of the world. This is the most painful thing.

The face of knowledge is a blessedness that has blossomed only for us. It is not just the face of India, but the face of the world. Santhigiri's path of knowledge is to take back and experience the sacrifice of sacrifice and the yaga of yaga, and to rise up. This path is ordained by God.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition 2000
False Purity is Not the Truth

Life is a current story full of hardships hidden in the synonym of bliss. The era that leads such a life is called Kali. Even though the meaning of the word Kali indicates a great glory, no one considers it to have that merit. In the imagination of time determination, the time called Kali has a resolve. The time concept of Kali is determined to reveal the truest thing, to act without blemish, and to propagate the highest Dharma of the divine resolve.

Ninety-nine percent of the human race is born in a time when Dharma was destroyed. What to do, we are also obliged to experience its difficulties. We stand on the path of Dharma to experience what came through birth. Yes, the path of Dharma that came by birth!

Those who evaluate the glory of creation may not be able to think about the length of time or in what way the world gathering (Loka Sangraham) can be achieved until they attain the capability to be called the karmic course of origin. Because for a person who has to live within a hundred years, complete all their karmas, and leave, the experience on earth is as empty as a spark in the sky. The situation is not different even for a person with self-purity.

What should we first imagine in the infinite expanse of the sky to have a small understanding of the creative glory of the divine resolve (Brahmanischayam)? In it, forests, hills, lakes, and seas—thus the power centers situated beyond the horizon and the karmic skills aligned with them, to what extent can we discover and know them? Even the facilities that have accelerated the speed of travel with such an abundance of vehicles are too limited to fully discover even the earth, which is a tiny dot in this universe.

We usually remember the secrets of birth and death created by the father, grandfather, great-grandfather, paternal, and maternal aspects, and the beautiful concepts attained through life, by attaching them to the purity of the sky. There we have memories of pure truth. But what is actually hidden inside the sky that creates this purity? If we do not think about the dust particles and hard rocks contained in it, how futile will our evaluation be? The gross, subtle, causal, and effective aspects which are the cause of origin that we imagine as pure are similar to this.

Why were we born, why do we live, why must we die—if not to find the answer to this riddle, why should we rely on the Vedantic proclamations that externally overflow with purity? Are we owners of a mind and intellect that carry the heavy loads of Dwaita-Advaita arguments and Puranic epics?

What is our existence? The five senses, the five elements, the five sheaths, and the nine vitalities (Navachaitanyas) that exist hidden and manifest, turning and reaching as life and soul—the strength of the sum of all this is contained in us. But we are unable to think about any of this. Because we are enjoying the fun of the puppet show played together by scholarship and ignorance, and the pride and lack of knowledge born from them. We do not think about the depth of the sky that spreads beyond our thoughts. We do not think about the regulating power of the science consisting of nine planets, twelve zodiac signs, and twenty-seven stars. Thus, we do not think about the Navajyothi that wears and covers infinite crores of solar systems and Milky Ways. We do not think about the path, purpose, and witness that can help us gain the weight of Navajyothi in our existence. We do not think about how the nine, twelve, and twenty-seven imagined in the new world creation spread in the distances of the sky in whatever nature. Because of that, how meaningless our life has become?

Can a human being reach divine thought only through calculations measuring from the atom to the infinite (Akhandam)? Or else, can we attain the supreme state standing in the imaginary karma of emptiness that destroys boundaries using the argumentative Maya and the illusionist's concept that is divided into spiritual and material? If we determine infinity using the calculation of years and the measuring rod of light and sound, does it mean the soul has been elevated and has overcome the blocks of knowledge one by one? The path of Dharma and the path of emptiness, the revolution of creation, and their distances are definitely attainable for us. We can also purify that attainability and keep it as pure truth. It is enough if we act by participating in the divine resolve (Brahmanischayam) of Santhigiri, which realizes the gross, subtle, causal, and effective matters from the atom to the infinite, without the difference of male or female, functioning with the five senses, five elements, and five sheaths, working in harmony with life and soul.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition 2000
The Guiding Religion

Standing at the position of knowledge, and standing at the supreme positions of the presence of Ishwara, Deva, Brahma, and Parabrahma through 74440 visions (Darshanas), the Guru is the truth of truths that brings each person to that level. The essence of life is to experience up to the presence of Parabrahma by firmly standing on that truth. By reaching that level of experience, one can perceive the special karmas across Yugas. The Guru, who is the truth of this truth, is the Lord of the world who showers compassion on the presences of Ishwara, Deva, Brahma, and Parabrahma.

A human being cannot even guess the duration of a Yuga, especially the Satyayuga. Because compared to the length of a Yuga, a human lifespan is like that of a worm. The contemporary scholarship of such a human acts as if it is a huge treasury of knowledge. Or suppose they have written some special news. The account of 12000 divine years, which is the duration of a Chaturyuga, is incomprehensible to the contemporary scholar. Then what about the Manvantaras consisting of 71 Chaturyugas! Even if we agree that the nature of every Chaturyuga is the same, it is impossible to determine the nature of a Manvantara.

With the knowledge that the Manvantara came through the resolve of the Saptarishis, the histories of Nanmukhan and Trimurti have been mixed up and written. We are not going to understand anything from this mix-up. Let's say there is a knowledgeable person who, standing in this realm of knowledge, tries to explain in detail the preserved karmas by cutting down every forest formed on this earth, discarding what should be discarded, keeping what should be kept, and refining them according to the times. If they write down what was preserved, refined, and destroyed giving each a position, will it become truth? If we calculate the size of the earth based on the measurements taken by someone, does it mean we have walked and seen all sides of the earth? To write the history of the earth, we must study what the moon and sun are, which helped in its sprouting and growth—what their special accounts are. Following that, we must study the calculation of the solar system. We must study the calculation by which these nine spherical bodies are rotating from the gravitational field. We have just managed to write this down in some way as 12 zodiac signs, 27 stars, and 9 planets. By walking and studying through this, we cannot write history, which is the glory of times. Because our understanding of the Creator and the Trimurtis is not correct.

What is the magnitude of the karma of the Last Prophet? We are all contained in the karma of the Last Prophet. Like the Hindu belief that everything will end with Kali, nothing is going to end with Kali. How can a Manvantara be evaluated with the knowledge that understands the end of Chaturyuga, mentions the good and bad of Kali, and assumes everything ends at the end of Kaliyuga? Suppose we stand firm on the doctrine stated as the Last Prophet. If the prophetic karma is completed just like that, how will Chaturyugas or Manvantaras be added and brought together?

So that is not what we need to know. We need someone to tell us how much Dharma will be correct in the course of karma starting from the Gurus, prophets, Trimurtis, and Saptarishis who have come so far. Only then can we move forward. We don't need to correct the mistakes made by our predecessors, nor do we need to exaggerate what they said correctly. This is the karma of vision (Darshana) that should be seen with utmost scrutiny.

The matter of seven skies is mentioned in many doctrines. By stating the calculation of the solar system, it has been brought up to the stellar sphere and confined to the karmic course of twenty-seven stars. Beyond this, if determined through science and convinced by stating a distance of twenty-five thousand, fifty thousand, or one lakh light-years, does it mean the qualities of the Lord of the world have been added to life? Suppose a soul gets the possibility to travel up to a hundred light-years. How will it reach the remaining distances? By studying the history and times of historians and Puranic authors who have beautifully embellished history at the highest level of artistic excellence, what benefit do we get? Even if calculations are stated as this many thousand Yojanas in old accounts, or this many thousand light-years in new accounts, there is no story of experience in it.

So none of this is what we need to know. The distances, times, and alignments mentioned do exist. What is the skill of life's journey within what exists, what is its glory, who made this experienced, from where can this knowledge be obtained—that knowledge is what should grow, regulate, and sustain us. Darshana is the medium that convinces and is convinced of this knowledge. All the great people who try to say this finally end up in Maya, Mahamaya, Bhagavanmaya, Tripudi, Trikalajnana, and Parashakti. Standing there, stating the depth of good deeds and the abyss of bad deeds, getting disappointed in the perspective of life, we must understand the intention behind saying that only this much can be known about the truth, it is impossible to reach the complete truth, or if anyone says they did, it's a lie.

This glory of imagination is what we have obtained so far. The history of the great souls who have come so far is also clear to us. The skill of the artists who describe good and bad is also clear. By evaluating and analyzing all this, we are not going to get anything. We shouldn't be evaluating whether another person has reached the level of a certain great soul, or if a certain doctrine has flaws or not.

As far as our predecessors, the great souls, reached, it is true. We respect that. But the experiential doctrine that determines the delays according to Yugadharma, and the growth and decay of times - this is what we need. The doctrine that knows everything through vision (Darshana). Some call the greatness of that doctrine an open space. Some say it is deep. Some say it has no depth. Which of these should we evaluate and know?

We must evaluate and know Sree Krishna, who was born a Jnani, Buddha who stands within the greatness of sacrifice, Vardhamana Mahavira, Guru Nanak, Jesus, and Prophet Muhammad who conducted prayers of supplication. At that position, if we play around talking about Maya, Mayavi, and Mayavinodan, how far can we carry the burden of Dharma? How far did the star called Avatar reach, and what benefit remains from it? Scientists say they rushed through their most powerful instruments and discovered knowledge beyond the boundaries of the universe. They say they found up to eighty thousand light-years. If stated just like that, where is God on this path?

How will the calculation that turns from the earth and the moon sphere and reaches the constellation of stars, reach Yugadharma, complete Yugadharma to reach Chaturyugadharma, and complete Chaturyugadharma to reach Manvantaradharma? How will we agree with the theoreticians who propagate Dharma without valuing any of this? The storytelling that none of this exists is not acceptable to us or anyone else. Because this does not become a guiding light (Margadarshanam).

The Guru is the guide who completely performs the guidance of the gross, subtle, causal, and effective aspects of the universe, which transforms from the atom to the infinite. That Guru is the path truly shown by God. If we evaluate the great souls of the past, disturb them, and justify them, we will not be able to fully acquire the greatness of guidance. Our Darshana doctrine is what shows us that no matter which prophetic path or guiding path of the scholars or the ignorant it is, it is not far for us. But we need to start again from one.

None of the great souls who came were here to do bad things. But they did not reach complete guidance. They reached a certain distance. The Guru is the special power that tells about the path to cross from that state. Thus, the distance yet to be discovered is the secret of life. The religion of the visionary (Deerghadarshi Matham) is the resurrection and the path of all living beings and all kinds of goodness. What we need to investigate is whether that visionary made a mistake.

If a mistake was made, how? Is it a mistake that came through the lineage of religions, or the mistake that came through prophetic religions? Or is it the mistake of stating the Nanmukhan system, tying it up in Trimukham (Trimurtis), and rejecting the fourth face, the face of knowledge? Or is it the mistake of creating the story of Adam and Eve? If that is the case, we don't have to put in much effort. It is enough to examine the history of 1500 or 2000 years.

So none of this is what we need. We must experience the greatness of what God has given. This is not in the karma of completing the 'Ma' mantra after the scholar's 'Ra' fades away. A section of scholars interprets Ramayanam (meaning Rama's history should fade away); when the four Vedas, six Shastras, and eighteen Puranas were completed, Dwaita and Advaita awakened - we cannot simply discard all this. What is there to interpret so much about all this? Through the eighteen Puranas, Vyasa said only two things,
Doing good to others is a virtue (Punya)
Harming others is a sin (Papa).

We do not know how to do this mentioned good for others. Even if we don't know how to do good, let there at least be no sin in life. We must work and make others work for that. This is the goodness of life. How we should praise the truth that reveals this to us! This is the benefit of praising and glorifying. For that
Unless there is experience in the beginning,
There is no understanding of it beforehand by the eye.

We must be convinced of at least this much. If it becomes like the truth-telling of the Sabarimala pilgrims, it will not be convincing. There is an experiential story where, when asked, "How tall is Sabarimala, Periyaswamy?", Periyaswamy replied, "It is as tall as two big coconut trees."

For us, just hearing or seeing is not enough. We must go the way God showed to know what the truth is. That is the greatest quality a human being should have. Today, we can experience it up to the level of proof. This is the time for that. Santhigiri does not complete things by saying something exists or does not exist. But the Darshana that completely makes the guidance experienced is here. This is the time that helps everyone get the fortune for that.
Guruvani

The Lineage of the Workers of Truth

The matter that was not obtained by the great souls who came across the Yugas has been brought through you, who know nothing, who have no experience of hearing or seeing anything. This matter was obtained by divine will (Brahmecha). If you cannot honor and take it, it will shift away not just from you, but from your lineage itself. Because of that, great dangers will befall your lineage. You must only act exactly as you are told. Especially those who have performed Guru Pooja should not do what is not told or what is not permitted. You must never apply your intellect in matters you are told not to do. If you apply intellect, you won't even be able to think about what will happen. You yourselves are convinced of what has happened to each person and each family who did not obey the word. Even in the families of those who did no harm to the establishment, hardships occurred due to disobedience. What you have been given is something no one in the world has ever received. That is, the karma of correcting the mistakes that have occurred across the Yugas. That is what God wishes to fulfill through you.

Initially, your shortcomings were being removed. Soon, you were also authorized to remove them from the world. Whoever applied their intellect in that, all faced adversities. It was those who were with me in the early days and the people of this land who thought they would never mentally drift away from here. But when they did unwanted things, they just moved away on their own. Not because anyone said anything. They were the ones who said they wouldn't leave even if killed. What did I do for all that to happen? Was it because they saw any mistake in me? This has been entrusted to you. If you cannot take this forward straight, what can I do?

It has been said that there will be some births hereafter in the families that have performed Guru Pooja and in the families of those who live lovingly knowing nothing. All the necessary rituals for that have been completed here. After nineteen ninety-five, the good ancestors who have been kept aside in the families that performed Guru Pooja will start taking birth within five to seven years. Such births are coming for the world rather than just for our families. That is why it is said you shouldn't do anything to spoil it. Even if you don't know anything, let that divine will happen in you.

Yours is a lineage that called upon God giving offerings. You have no information about anything. You are accustomed to seeing everything trivially. You, the householders, are getting more clarity than what a Sanyasi or a Rishi gets. You don't know why you are getting this or how you should live this. Just like you, there are children from your homes standing here. If you yourselves don't inform them respectfully, they will also become spoiled like you.

You are the ones who should hear what the word of God is, immerse yourselves in it, and act. You are not the ones who should act using small intellects, fall here and there, and rot away. Across different times, God sent many great souls to earth for you. Due to lack of wisdom or karmic flaws, you couldn't grasp their ideas. The eras that have passed are very long. The eras yet to come are also very long. I have experienced the hardships of the disasters in these long eras.

You should not get isolated. My wish is that you should live like the children of one father. Other than wishing so, what can I do before the truth? I have done everything so that you never have to suffer or fail. You all are workers of the truth. You must wish and work to become so. May God bless you. I wish that the divine power (Brahmasakthi) shows mercy on you.
Guruvani

The State of Human Lineage

What is the measure of what is described as visionary, yogi, sage, or devotee? Are we qualified in the karma that shares the right and wrong within this measure? We do not have this thought. A part of karma where Jesus Christ asked, "Father, why have you forsaken me?" A part of karma of the Hindus where Sree Rama and Sree Krishna stand. Which of these parts of karma can we safeguard? Or can we complete it using science?

Shaivism that says everything is 'Shivoham' (I am Shiva); Vaishnavism that says everything is Bhagavan's Maya. Shakteyam that says everything is Parashakti. We must see where the Hindus, who accepted as everything the karmic parts whose completion was achieved by singing and praising in these traditions, stand today. When these sects fought each other and strengthened class hatred, one group became Christians, one group became Muslims, and another group became rationalists and realists.

Standing within the lineage of written histories, it is foolishness to say I do not believe in it. Thus, standing in a predicament from which no one can escape, we are traditionally following it. Standing in this lineage, we cannot move even an inch forward. The descendants of those who lived with great grandeur in our land at one time have all migrated to foreign lands today. That ancestral home lies destroyed and erased. Can this karmic flaw of wandering be hidden by calling it grandeur?

The history of the Ettuveetil Pillamar is a tale of plunder. They are the ones who ruled this land. What they might have ruled can be easily guessed. This same history is what has been and is happening not just in India, but all over the world wherever there are humans. America is the place created by driving out the looters from all countries. Today they are the greatest before all countries. Thus, a predicament that can never be overcome stands before us. Standing on this foundation, no one can achieve anything; we must primarily know this. Those who still follow this lineage will only become more and more violent. We are a lineage gripped by karmic flaws of arrogance and meaninglessness, having lost humility. Ignorance, where not only caste and religion but all kinds of hatred are intertwined, is our hallmark. Each of us is the balance sheet of each of our predecessors trying to become great.

We must strive until this trash becomes a gem. We must know where we will anchor that effort. For that, we must know the karma of the past twenty-five Chaturyugas and the three Chaturyugas that lay empty before that. We must believe only in that.

The great souls who came and went were anyway more sacrificial than us. If they had to face the tragedy of their entire lives and ideas being rejected, where will we end up if we merely believe and make others believe scientific theories that only look at the seen without knowing the causes and effects?

It does not mean science is not good. Science is good if its destructive power is avoided. The guidance of science, which was able to formulate the biological subtle principle of molecules, is indeed great. But science can do nothing in the aspect of making one capable of acquiring the Dharma, having seen what the karma capacity grown with the help of the five elements in the atmosphere is, and having recognized the Dharma that is its cause and effect.

If a person says he wants to live, it means he desires some path. Therefore, we should not be strangers in the matter of achieving Dharma through life. Our lack of knowledge to achieve Dharma in this way is the cause of our complete destruction.

The path of Santhigiri is the way given by God to reclaim the Dharma that we have lost. Knowing what happened to the 2444 Acharyas, we must think about what we should do now in light of that knowledge. We have come as the successors of the karma performed by these great souls. We must think about how to change that karma from their state of no salvation. That cannot be achieved by our karma alone. For that, we must have a special progeny. Here we will again have doubts. By imparting such a thought of karma, we reach Atma Dharma by combining and fulfilling the karma paths of ours and our lineages. This is the Dharma we must give to the world. When we earn the merit for it, our doubts will disappear by themselves.
Guruvani

Illusions in the atmosphere

The power of karma, where truth and falsehood are mixed on the path of the mistake that happened knowingly or unknowingly twenty-five Chaturyugas ago, has become strong in four divisions: Yoga, Karma, Bhakti, and Jnana. This mistake endangered the very wisdom of the world. There is no understanding of cause and effect. Elaborate additions that create a festive atmosphere have been added to the content of miracles. By teaching and preaching those miracles, they made the masses fearful, and the aura of Yoga Tantra and simple theories created by magicians emerged.

A simple theory means that the disciple should obey the Guru in the Guru-disciple relationship. Vaimanika Shastra (aeronautical science), which emerged during the time of Sree Rama, is proof of the disciple not obeying the Guru in this way. Vaimanika Shastra should not have been propagated at that time. It is a science that should have been propagated at the end of Dwapara Yuga and the beginning of Kali Yuga. With the knowledge of Vaimanika Shastra, the modern life of the coming times should have been organized. That is, Vaimanika Shastra should have been practiced for the honesty of spiritual life.

The daily life presented by modern intellectuals and the majority of ascetics are copies of miracles. But there is one thing they need to understand. We have ended up in the interval of a long period that acted without knowing the reality of the conceptual creation of the solar system, and the Yaga and sacrifice of the Saptarishis, without determining the time. Without correcting the mistake that happened in the beginning, the heroes of logic and liberation destroyed the uniqueness of the times by standing on that mistake and writing down miracles and Yoga Vidya together.

This is the truth about Ishwara Seva (service to God) that creates a festive atmosphere. Those who make joyous shouts while bursting crackers are the workers of this miraculous creation. The devotees of God perished in fear and misery, mistaking this for Brahma Vidya. The group that preserves the body for three hundred, five hundred, and a thousand years and works for the liberation of the soul is a technique that combines all this and makes it even more astonishing. What else is the use of such people other than to use them instead of huge cutouts? Is this a work that helps any evolutionary function of the soul? This not only misleads poor spiritual beings. It also created a distance where ordinary people moved away from the good ones and could never find a pure life of truth. This is only good for telling astonishing stories but has no connection with the truth.

When Sanyasa was seen in this state, the moral life that humans had to share with true life was destroyed. What else is there in this other than the foresight of the monkey army in the Ramayana? The stars that happen as comets are the brutal karma that imparted spiritual life in this way. It is due to the harshness of these comets that wars occur even in the places they travel. Once a comet larger than the earth rushed towards the earth. Another time it rushed to hit the face of Jupiter. So this is the purpose of these comets. These are what are called unparalleled Yoga Bhrashtas (fallen from Yoga). Even if it is said that banyan trees have spread and provided shade for thousands of years, there will be no core in it. May God never let us mingle with the Yoga Bhrashtas who lead to destruction by being caught in empty practices like this!
Guruvani
