The truth that transcends the limits of the three worlds

The aspect of vision is present in all religious denominations. All religions have the same aspect of vision. The aspect of vision in Hinduism has come completely through the Trimurti system. There are many mistakes in the rituals of the Trimurti system. Today there is a situation where it is impossible to distinguish the mistakes in it from the rightness of the vision aspect. The reason for this is that the theoreticians of the many sects in Hinduism carry their own learning and scholarship and the evils of that learning.

The owner of the soul himself sees through the vision aspect what the divine nature of the soul has evolved from. Such a philosophy of vision is rarely heard in religious theories. Manusmriti is a very extensive code of conduct that emerged from the mouth of Swayambhuva Manu. It says the following about the vision of the true self:
Evam ya sarvabhuteshu pashyanyatmanamatmana
Sa sarvam samatametya brahmabhyeti param padam.
He who realizes his own self in all animate and inanimate beings attains identity with everything and merges into Brahman, the supreme abode.

Siddhas who are visionaries know some things about self-realization. In the context of Hinduism, it is Sree Krishna and later Sree Sankara who have spoken giving importance to vision among those whom Hindus have respected and honored to date. If there are any flaws in their visionary perspective, it is not a mistake in their communication. It is a flaw in the descriptions of religious theorists and scholars. This mistake has existed for the past twenty-five Chaturyugas. The first opportunity to correct this mistake by the will of Brahman was in the Trimurti lineage. But the Trimurti lineage traveled on the wrong path during the first three Chaturyugas. No one knows the calculation of those Chaturyugas.

From the fourth Chaturyuga onwards, creative and cognitive efforts were made to prove again what the secret of evolution is. This evolutionary process reached the position of Devendra in the Trimurti system, or up to the position of Parashakti. The position of Devendra means that Dharma acted from a demon to the extent of being worshipped. Religious theorists describe the position of Devendra in their language and logic.

It took ten Chaturyugas to complete the Trimurti state in India. The Trimurti system did not achieve a traditional knowledge capable of going beyond ten Chaturyugas. Manusmriti is the only code of conduct that we believe and obey as traditional knowledge. That is what is called Sanatana. Fourteen Manus are mentioned in the Manu lineage. The period of a Manu is a Manvantara. One Manvantara is seventy-one Chaturyugas. Along with the evolution of the Chaturyuga, the revolution of the Sun, Moon, and Earth, and the planetary positions in that revolution occur. Planetary positions can be found out through the aspect of vision.

The length of a Chaturyuga is estimated to be twelve thousand divine years. The length of a Chaturyuga is unimaginably large. Then the length of a Manvantara is unimaginably large. So many crores of Gurus come before a Manvantara is completed. All logic in the nature of worship will enter in between. The goal and achievement of a Manvantara should be understood at such a distance.

Currently, it is the time of the seventh Manu, Vaivasvata Manu. The Manu lineage begins with Swayambhuva Manu. What has been continuing since the end of the third Chaturyuga, where the mistake occurred, is the same thing. Because when the reign of one ruler is over and the next government comes, they rule by looking at the past governing principles. The Trimurti system has also grown similarly. The maximum calculation in it is the lord of the Ganas (Ganapathi). That is the star group. Although this star group seems to have the shape of Ganapathi, it actually has a human shape. Along with this calculation, the calculation of twenty-seven stars, twelve zodiac signs, and nine planetary positions was also written and added. Changing it into the calculation of Yamas, they divided a day into eight Yamas. It is not possible for humans to act based on the calculation of Yamas. Because they stand in the Trimurti system, Hindus do not have the capability to act based on the calculation of Yamas. Since people of other religions and theoreticians stubbornly act in their own theories, it became impossible for them as well, just like Hindus.

Hindus have a stage of incarnation for everything. What is meant by incarnation is the atomic vibration that comes to the creative stage due to the halo of twenty-seven stars. When Vedantins and scientists see this atomic vibration, they feel a sense of greatness. It is such people who are born in zodiac signs and stars. They do not know that the complete knowledge of the solar system is beyond this. But scholars say this in their calculations. But they lack the ability to preserve it. Because due to the mistake made by the Acharya in the Manu lineage, they are speaking the truth of the misconception that "I myself am Brahman". They completed and used the Chaturvakya within that limitation. Still, they stopped at the limit of the three worlds. They could not even reach the face of knowledge.

Since the time this mistake occurred, poets and those associated with them had to write standing in a measure where they only mentioned Earth, Heaven, and the Underworld. They have reached the conclusion that no one can act by looking into the history of India, which is so old. Therefore, they took the possibilities of Chaturyugas and placed them in Parashakti. They also brought it to the understanding that no one could change it. Thus, after acting for ten yugas, knowledge and ignorance grew in it equally. Then, instead of the karma called the practice of knowledge, they refined it and wrote it in Sanskrit up to the multiplication tables. There are calculations written and kept up to one Mahani, and calculations saying a thousand Mahani is sixty-two and a half. When trying to write and complete in such calculations, they had to write and keep how long a Deva's year is. Human years were also kept similarly. This is how it has been kept in other religions as well.

This has happened in the class theory of Hinduism from the beginning. Therefore, the scholarly assembly that has come so far faced the misfortune of not being able to act knowing the time. Bringing in Vedic rituals based on astrological calculations, everyone gave it completion. Shaivites, Vaishnavites, and Shakteyans have brought completion through their own Puranas and epics. None of the Vedic literatures in the world are different from this. Therefore, no great man could move forward. In this way, twenty-five Chaturyugas passed after completion.

Currently, it is the Kali Yuga of the twenty-eighth Chaturyuga of the seventh Manvantara. Now, in the place where Kali Dharma should happen, the Trimurti system came and wrote down "Kali destruction". People got involved and stood in the karma written in that way. Kali is not destruction. Krita Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dwapara Yuga, Kali Yuga - when each of these was written and completed, the calculation of the face of knowledge somehow decreased. That is how it had to be written as "Kali destruction".

Speaking with the knowledge of Santhigiri, this became a curse from Brahman. In Kali, it is said that whether it is a demon, a goddess, a god, or whatever there is up to the Trimurti position, everything will appear and instruct. It is instructed for credibility that whatever science one learns, whatever one writes or practices, it should not be applied without a Guru. Thus, four types of Gurus have grown in India and three types of Gurus in other countries. As a result of that, taking a part from each of the eighteen Puranas, it has been told as a play, a story, and the illusory play of God. There is no doubt that God's illusion itself is being told in an astonishing way and made into a story and a play.

In the karma called faith, one traveled calling it destruction without looking back. However, when it came to physiology, the result of the stars and the three-faced practice proved to be true in the place where our practice should be fulfilled. On that path, when the three sects of the Trimurti system competed and fought with each other, they stood on the path where Aham Brahmasmi was not experienced through worship of God. Instead, they brought in a language that came into culture by studying word forms and grammar.

Man is born in all the Ganas that exist, starting from the Deva Gana. Such men thought hard and wrote that Kali is destruction. With that, the religious theories that came by dividing into Savarna and Avarna collapsed. The castles in the air built with them collapsed. Looking at it that way, the karma in the Trimurti Yugas, which stood so strong for so long, did not work either.

Man needs to take back at least a part of the knowledge and correct this Chaturyuga system through experience. It is then that the calculation in the Dharma Shastra called Manusmriti returns. Until today, no one has been able to take it back. Because due to the completion of the Trimurti system, everything became Maya and Mahamaya. All those who followed the path of Advaita lost their karma; Dharma and merit ceased to exist. They did not know the misfortune that befell the part that grew up like that. For example, the blunder that happened to Devendra. Scholars did not hesitate to interpret even that as part of Maya.

One must surely see the Trimurti stage. If someone like that comes at any time, whatever can be done by him will be done. But a Shudra or a Brahmin could not achieve what was done in that way. Because this has been mentioned only vaguely. They have also fallen into the praises of the Goddess or the God.

How can goodness be obtained from punishing the body in the path of Yoga? We must think about this. A historical knowledge of having studied physiology exists even today. Among the many efforts made to firmly establish the mistake that occurred initially, there is also the nature of teaching and preparing by giving rewards. It is such accumulations that are the eighteen Puranas, the calculation of twenty-seven stars, twelve zodiac signs, and nine planetary positions. This cannot be divided by calculation. There is a calculation suitable for dividing it like that. It is not like this one mentioned.

Everything from demons to Devendra or Parashakti has been reached and stopped. Then its sub-divisions. When it became so, each religious theorist studied their own karma along with other theories, and human dharma changed into each caste and religion, ending up in a miserable state where it could not be taken back. The government and the people under its influence - we are in a situation where we cannot take back any of this. It is as a way of this that the author of the Gita taught us Karma Yoga.

Some people were made Avarna, incomplete, and nowhere. When parents and children attained different pleasures, culture was lost. It is to recover what was lost that Guru Pooja is performed at Santhigiri. This karma belongs to seven generations. This is claimed using the soul. By bringing class consciousness through karma and making each operate again, it came to Trimurti (evolution). Not allowing anyone to pass beyond that, Yogis, Jinn, and Antaryamis misled, and there was not even a single Guru to instruct in the aspect of foresight. If it is not a karma capable of earning merit without losing capital, there is no other use than just wasting it. This ignorance has been adopted as many stories and sciences and brought as wealth for the world.

Guru Pooja at Santhigiri is the karma to take this back. The retrieval that had not happened so far is being completed here. A child with the inner vision to see in philosophy will understand all the Devas, Goddesses, Rishis, and Sanyasis. The generation to come belongs to such children. By calling this good time when such children are born as destruction, and instead showing miracles, the dignity of time was lost. Although these miraculous powers were good for the respective times, when its intellect was applied in the Dharma of Kali, the country became enslaved in every way due to politics, labor, and wages.

If you feel the truth in Santhigiri as truth, you will be able to see that truth sitting in any part of the world. Those who became Jnanis might not have been able to see this; because they became Jnanis by turning to the paths of Hatha Yoga, Jnana Yoga, Karma Yoga, and Raja Yoga. This Yoga Shastra is what has caused destruction in India. Understanding this truth, we must develop the knowledge to endure any amount of sacrifice so that karma is never destroyed. Otherwise, we will not be able to reach the path of correction. The vision of truth must be realized through sacrifice. Narayana Guru says,
Overflowing beyond the limits of the three worlds
The lamp that shines when the Triputi is destroyed
Will not be attained by the hypocritical ascetic
Remember the secret of the Upanishadic saying.

Incarnations come. It was brought into the story of Krishna and became useless for anything other than just giving it away like a collection. They will not accept the Guru's assignments in India. They want a God who shows miracles and performs tests. This miracle eventually resulted in the fourth face being pinched off. Crores of Devas, Goddesses, and Pitrus who lost the fourth face came, and whatever happened to the people, they had to act without any dignity for it. Not only in India, but this is the situation worldwide.

What is said here is this: in the completed state reached by the Deva, they made it appear as if everything is said by them due to the genetic nature of old birth tendencies. Therefore, religious theorists and scientists became completely unable to foresee anything of this. Sree Krishna's life is an example of this. Running, running, where all did he run! Is there at least one person who can understand if this detail is told? It is good and bad karma that has been going on for crores of years. We have taken ownership of this confusion. This is our lack of purpose.

Enslaved to the webs of theories, acting without knowing the Dharma of the Yuga, the special qualities attributed to all souls will be in a spiritual matter. But apart from dividing and changing it like buttermilk and horse gram, it will never be useful for taking it back. The correction is to be flowed and taken through tendencies. The correction is mainly needed for scholars. Because it is they who refined the language and follow it without knowing the story. That does not mean others don't need correction. The common people are those who, with the flaws of the lineage remaining, making the atmosphere polluted, coming into karma and earth, live without understanding anything and make life like a bunch of flowers thrown to the ground.

There is an example in Santhigiri of correcting by flowing with tendencies. The children here do not get visions because they observed celibacy. They have a genetic quality of having lived in a Guru lineage at some time. This is their realization today, which they then bring to the path of Karma and the path of Dharma, preserving it as merit.

This is the fulfillment of birth. It is the arrangement that brings one to the path of Dharma. There is no time to tell all that. Not only householders, not only individuals, but even the flora and fauna that have come to this world so far are performing their respective karma. We might not know anything comprehensible about this. But we must understand some examples. If some medicines are touched by women during their menstrual period, they will wither away. This care is not there in Western countries. What all dangers have they caused due to this lack of care. We have also moved like the Westerners towards the ignorance of making postgraduate degrees and doctorates into earnings in pieces, bringing money and capability, and forgetting the truth.

Thinking again and again about the reason for the mistake that happened to us, the Guru-disciple relationship in Santhigiri is a power of karma completed through action, words, and eyes. Rishis, Sanyasis, Yogis, and Jnanis in all spheres are earning knowledge and wealth and perishing, like going around an oil mill, unable to recognize what the path of Karma is. Just as the path of Ashtavakra with eight bends occurred because the father who is the Guru and the son who is the disciple parted ways without respecting the Guru-disciple relationship in the father-son bond, the above-mentioned paths of Karma also went wrong.

Therefore, if the vision is not corrected without flaws, the result of the effort, the truth, and the untruth cannot be retrieved. The paths belonging to the Trimurti lineage have become confused like this. Here, we ourselves are completely seeing and being convinced of the course of karma that has occurred in the tradition. This is the subject of Santhigiri. It is not to create Sanyasis, Yogis, and Jnanis here. These stages should come of their own accord by God's grace. This lineage should be preserved forever and imparted to their children. This is the goal here.

The world does not have this tendency. That is the reason why the theory remained unclear to the visionaries who came so far. The children here are seeing the vision of what evolutionary action is. Evolutionary action provides the ease of times. This is the Dharma of Kali. We are struggling to submit this purpose and goal to God. Understanding this, we wish to see all people reach the path of Karma.

Far-reaching visions are the goal and vision of the lineage. God has appointed this Guru lineage to correct the mistake that occurred to the Acharya in the Manu lineage, to take up and perform the Karma and Dharma of the Trimurti lineage without discarding them, and to bring back the Sanatana Dharma that existed before the mistake.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition 2000
The History of Santhigiri's Concept of God

What is Sanatana! We have been taught that it is Hindu Dharma. In what way have we been taught this? Just as the Hindu path of vision says Shakteya, Shaiva, Vaishnava, or Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, this is also seen in other religions with a different imaginative specialty. It is only in their language. But when it comes to the part of knowledge, this is not correct.

What was previously called Sanatana is a history with four faces. What are these four faces? It is a system functioning as the faces of Krita Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dwapara Yuga, and Kali Yuga. It is showing us how the functioning of these four faces is. It is passing it on to your children. It will change only after taking it to Satya Yuga. It is after that we must know and act on what is to come in the future. We have to believe that this will not change even if humans change it. If we can remove at least the size of a grain of sand from a great karmic flaw decreed by fate, according to our capacity within the measure of Brahman's will, that is enough. Then it will spread to all parts of the world. After spreading, it will be experienced by all religious theories in our long history. They will preserve it and contribute it to the world.

Looking at the world as a whole, it has been informed that after the time of Krishna, 2444 Gurus came for this correction. But they could not correct it. When they correct a little, they will be driven away somehow. You can see a brief detail of it from the time of Moses. Those who have studied history know what all they made that great man do after it started. After that, until the time of Jesus, things like this kept coming. Even though all those came, they only show a path of guidance for 100 years, 200 years, 500 years, 1000 years, up to 2000 years. Beyond this, a path of guidance cannot be said regarding them. You might think that with this the world will turn to ashes. It is not like that. When we think that the guidance left by these great souls is only this much, who will we become?

I am telling the history of our concept of God. This historical truth belongs to the mistake that has been coming for twenty-five Chaturyugas. For this long, this mistake has remained in the atmosphere and spread. It is as a result of this that the world sank into such a disaster. To solve this mistake, God brought 2444 Gurus and Prophets within the last 5000 years. They could not achieve it. If God has chosen us to correct that mistake, or if God wishes to fulfill that karma through us, poor people who know nothing, how lucky each of you who are part of that karma are, how fortunate! How should we respect that power which informed this in advance? Even if we can act only for a moment, it must be done correctly. If done so, the result of that karma will remain here. No one will take it away. We should think about how to carry forward that underlying power of the soul.

The path of Santhigiri is the decree of Brahman. It is this path of the decree of Brahman that is called Sanatana. You are praying to a name and form capable of fulfilling a special karma given by God to complete this karma. What do you see when you pray to this? How many karmic flaws ancestors brought through worship, how much it is spread in this world - from this little child to the mothers are seeing it.

When you see this, you will have many kinds of pain. There will be no one to pamper you when you see this. Sometimes you will even get kicked and beaten. Still, you should have the confidence and knowledge that "I will do this". What was the need for Krishna's father and mother to sit in prison to give birth to Krishna? What did we turn Krishna into? This is the knowledge and experience gained from Hindu Dharma. This knowledge itself has continued for so long. If this is not changed, we will keep going towards a karma that destroys the world. Because of the mistake in this system, crores of souls are standing polluted in the atmosphere.

A few years ago, a stone came down from the atmosphere. It exploded and fell into the sphere of Jupiter. It was not a stone. It was a meteor. Scientists initially thought it was coming to Earth. Just as it fell in the sphere of Jupiter, it is waiting to fall in other spheres as well. To cause such destruction, it circled for so many miles. Such a huge scene is waiting above us. This can happen in any part of this solar system. Then it will overturn all theories of Yuga Dharma. It is about this destroyer that Jesus gave us evidence. Saying, "Satan, go away". It didn't go. It continued until the cross. Similarly, this Satan destroyed all the great souls who came to date. The karmic flaw that came by theorizing this Satan is ruling us. Those who go to holy places dying in accidents, even Sanyasis fighting and dying making claims at festival places, and dying while stoning Satan, all fall within the specifics of devotion. In this way, many kinds of karmic flaws that end in death happen in the name of our theories. We must think about how we can change these karmic flaws. It is to change this that God is making us pray here. Therefore, while you pray, you should resolve that whatever karmic flaws have occurred in this world through the system of worship, they should change, and the souls that stand corrupted due to the flaws in worship should get rebirth or be destroyed.

The daily prayer at Santhigiri is such a karma. God is making us do this service to the world. Brahma Muhurtha is an excellent circumstance for the true Dharma that we have prepared. Religious theories, Puranas, epics, and various kinds of theories have tried in many ways to convince about the things that came through the system of worship where mistakes occurred for so many Yugas. All these attempts are their intellectual exercises. If one tries to complete God using literacy, will it be helpful for the execution of Brahman's decree? You must think about this.
Guruvani
Guru Jayanthi Edition 2000
The story of the pain of many great souls

You are educated, knowledgeable, and intelligent. Those of you who stand near me and those who come to stay here with me should know at least this much. Why do you come and stay here, or what is the purpose of your staying here? You must fully accomplish that purpose. Otherwise, each of you will move away. Even if you have knowledge, it will happen so due to your lack of wisdom.

How much have you lost here? If I had arranged a management and made them do this, would this much loss have occurred? It is only after seeing where your flaw is that this organization has been entrusted to you. But if you decide yourself that you will not improve, what can I do? There is no question whether you are a man or a woman, young or old, if you act knowingly, there will be no shortcoming here, no trouble will happen. If someone takes an item, at least you should be able to tell the one who took it to put it back. But for you, even if it is thrown into any dung pit, will you feel pain?

I did not call you here by troubling you. I did not call you here and ruin you. I gave you all the freedom to act as if it is your own property. What is your wish, just do that. I didn't look whether you are old people, people with a tradition, or new people. To me, old and new are all the same. You shouldn't stay near me thinking that I have some kind of partiality everywhere. If you think so, I will move away from you.

You don't have to do any work that brings you hardship and loss. Then, if you don't look after what is entrusted to you, those who don't look after it will be removed and someone else will be placed. Has anything been done here that makes it difficult for you to stand together and maintain things in any way? If one acts properly, another cannot act improperly. This organization, the karma here - you think whether it is needed or not. A person had a difficulty. He told it to the committee members. The committee members must resolve it. I should resolve it only if you cannot.

You have learned the respective aspects that you have become familiar with. If you copy what you have learned here, it will not be right. What you saw and knew until yesterday is right indeed. You got that much familiarity, didn't you? But you must also understand that you have a shortcoming and that God has given an opportunity to think about that shortcoming. My sorrow is that you are becoming incapable of utilizing that opportunity.

For crores of years, God brought this historical truth in many forms through the systems of prophets, the systems of Devas, and the systems of Rishis. Each system has been brought in each nature and in many familiarities. Similarly, independent paths like Jain and Buddha have spread in many ways. After Sree Krishna, crores of great souls have come. It's just that none of it has come out. Therefore, we don't have information about them. If you do not consider this as an opportunity given by God for us who are alive and for our ancestors to change the disasters that have occurred since ancient times, you will fail. This is my sorrow.

This is not a continuation of any other idea. We are doing the karma of taking everything good from what has come so far and preserving what is to come without flaws. The mistakes of what exists today cannot be changed suddenly. Human life is a truth where mistakes have to be corrected over many generations. Because life is a truth where right and wrong are mixed, spread across generations. Without knowing any of this, one is rushing to live somehow according to what is seen. The lives of those with great wealth and riches are no different. Each one is handling life as if they hold some greatness in their hands. What I have to say is that one should not destroy the goodness of one's own life by showing arrogance with money and wealth.

Our younger generation is self-destructing their karma and losing their culture due to some special tendencies that have come. That is why distorted tendencies are passed on. The elders are eager to nourish it. They are becoming independent, having nothing to say to anyone. Freedom is not something to say anything and do anything.

As far as we are concerned, this is not freedom. Create a karma capable of changing the mistake that happened to us and what currently exists. This is the freedom we need. Without the freedom for that, this mistake cannot be changed. Then, in the place where that mistake is changed, the freedom to give something to the people, the freedom to acquire the knowledge for it. Today we have the freedom to create knowledge in that way. You should consider this as the time permitted by God for that.

You shouldn't come here with the intention of achieving some temporary peace like going everywhere else. Whatever you can get, you may earn it. As a special thing from all that, you have a hymn from God to get from here. How to master this; this is what those standing here and coming here should know first. For that, you shouldn't act stubbornly and show this and that. It is not haste that is needed for this. Because this is not something to tie up tomorrow and find a reason to quarrel. You only have the knowledge to quarrel like that.

What I am telling is my familiarity and experience. I am telling a knowledge I learned through pain since my fourteenth year. You shouldn't think that I am telling about something where I lived happily in some way. Have you understood what is in my possession? It is a matter where many great souls came and suffered.

What have you learned? Our Swami is great, your Swami is small. That Swami then became God. Then it became the God of our caste. What I am saying is, you shouldn't come here for the matter of playing God in caste and becoming bad. There is no matter here to play God like that. If God is there, He is there, if not, He is not. You don't have to say and establish it. It is enough if you accept this to the extent of your experience. You are learning this here for the first time in human history. This cannot be learned by taking any course. There is no such method here. You should desire to take this only by suffering, going through pain, and finding joy in that pain. No matter how much you suffer, no fault will come. The more you suffer, the more joy you will get. You should behave here only in this idea. You shouldn't try to lift this up today and tomorrow to improve or ruin anyone. It is enough if you do this on behalf of God. Do what you can. Nothing more is needed. We don't know anything, we didn't come knowing anything, we are happy with those who know, we have fulfillment in working together with them - it is enough if you have such humility. Don't say or do anything stubbornly. That will be wrong. This is not going to happen with the greatness of doing things stubbornly. What is done without humility will become the mold of ignorance created without honesty. What is there to evaluate and know in a karma lacking humility and honesty?

There are some specialties where karma is advised to one person's intellect, mixed with another person's deceit and betrayal, entrusted to us, and operated through us. If you can do something for the good without falling and rotting in that, do it.

Be complete in karma done with patience. Everyone should be able to love you seeing your actions. Nobody should feel like leaving you and running away seeing your actions. You shouldn't go into such karma. How much greatness and depth love can be brought to - karma is for this.

All present organizations are organizations of caste and religion. All of them are standing ready to fight based on class division. Here you shouldn't prepare for anything in that state; don't do anything.

If not done, then not done, that's all. Don't grasp the aspect where you and others become bad by doing it. Businesses among the people, agricultural matters - the capability of functioning in these, culture, the basic aspect of survival, in which parts there is no knowledge; how much of this matter they can absorb and accept - you should act in him only taking all this into account. Otherwise, you and he will fall into danger.

Nowadays, the fighting spirit among political, religious, and caste organizations is very high. Everyone acts like they are the great ones, with no ordinary people left. The familiarity of such stubborn actions resides within you as well. Do not prepare to act and complete things based on that habit. We are none of this. What we must do first is to take responsibility for the mistakes committed by our ancestors. When taking up that mistake, there will be a corresponding determination and detachment (vairagyam) for it. When we say vairagyam, it is not the vengeance to beat and destroy others. Vairagyam is a great density of tolerance endured with love. Each of us should have the karmic ability to act with such detachment.

The girls in our homes will not stay with us for very long. Once they grow up, there is an anxiety to somehow send them away from the house. Whether it is a big house or a small house, the worry is to get the girl out of the house. And what if she is sent away? She has to adapt to the struggles there. Otherwise, she will come back home. Or else, she might even be killed. Parents are struggling through this, caught in a lineage entangled in all these issues. You should not show any such fuss. Let things happen as they naturally should in the world. There are some mischievous people who make a big deal out of all these noises. They think they are the greatest in the world. Nobody can simply become great or small like that. This is because this is a kind of nature developed from the circumstances in which humans have lived. Other than the fact that it has reached us too, no one on earth exists with only happiness. This is the result of the defects that have come into our past karmas.

What is the root cause of this defect? To what extent can we free ourselves from it? We have acquired restlessness from the influence of wandering ancestors, gods and goddesses, and many such evil karmic forces. Even today, we are unknowingly acquiring restlessness. And what is the action we are doing here? We are growing by making efforts to find a way for peace from all this. How much determination can we attain in this action—this is the thought we should have today and always. Do not think of anything else. There is no time for all that in this short life. Let those who are stubborn in caste and politics compete, think, and win in that path. We do not need to give much respect and importance to those foolish words.

Instead of arguing for someone else, isn't it better to be determined for your own good? Is there a need for both you and others to be destroyed together by being stubborn about correcting others? When you act on your own and that pain reaches the karma, you and those who suffer with you must ensure that the karma is not destroyed.

Keeping what someone else earned in the past as one's own is called 'Pandarappattam'. Is what has been converted into one's own property in this way the only thing that belongs to me? No, you should become completely firm in the actions you have to do on your own. Otherwise, you will have nothing to call your own. Coming, staying, and acting here should be for that purpose. Not to show off one's greatness. If you show off your greatness, your children will show off even more.

Education is essential for you. But the education that exists today is not enough. It is not an education suitable for the nature and culture of India. India had wealth, prosperity, name, and fame, right? How did it go away? Where are the seeds of India's destruction sown? If we learn things from somewhere else and piece them together without learning in a way suitable for India's culture, it means you are working to copy their greatness. It is not an action for your own betterment. If you do not have the knowledge to grasp and carry things forward yourself, you cannot even imagine the danger that is going to happen.

What I have to show you in this matter is an experience of a very long time. When I say an experience of a long time, it doesn't mean just the long time I have lived. It means taking up the karmic energy of great souls who have come over many ages. And their sorrow too.
Guruvani
October 2000

If we find the boundaries of a god or goddess or their retinues, how much have we really seen? In truth, this is nothing at all. At the very least, considering the visionary tradition of the past five thousand years, one should be able to unify a Guru, an Acharya, or a Prophet who came within it and move forward. Not a single religious theorist has been able to do this. We haven't even had the time to think about these things. Even if we had the time, we wouldn't be able to think like that. No one has thought beyond what Mahatmaji did. After that, it was Narayana Guru who thought more. Let us say we adopted a path like that of Sri Ramakrishna, Vivekananda, or Shankaracharya. How would we know which of these is right and which is wrong? Everything is in such disarray that it cannot be known.

A girl we raise becomes a mother. That girl should be able to preserve her own culture and an understanding of the country's progress. Who is working to raise her in that manner? Everyone is like a machine facing west. Other than singing what we learned and passing exams, what do we have of our own? If we are not looking west, we are interested in looking north. According to their logic, the tradition of Hindus lies in the north. Another section belongs to the Dakshinamurti faction. Because things got ruined in this way, we could not progress in any way.

Narayana Guru Swami has expressed sorrow over not having a child. The meaning of this is not as uncles say. For example, Nataraja Guru was someone Swami nurtured. Nataraja Guru could not carry forward that idea. Following that, not a single educated person even looked back at it. Everyone went after bookish knowledge by studying Vedanta. Advaita is great, Dvaita is small - if each such argument is made big and small, will the ideas or theories obtained through hardship be correct?

What is meant is that the successors could not do it. Nobody could adapt to and act according to that idea. There is no other field that acted as wrongly as the successors of Narayana Guru. The householders of India have never engaged in a karma of thinking about, growing in, and nurturing their swadharma as householders. One section completed it by speaking of Varnasrama dharma. Another section completed it by speaking of the Vedic religion. This is the logic of the Hindu. The logic of Christians and Muslims is no different. There has not been a single logic that is equally useful to all people. How can we overcome this shortcoming?

We are starting from where all the Acharyas who came and went had stopped. In the last five thousand years, about twenty-five Acharyas like Jesus and Moses came. Over two thousand Gurus came among the Hindus. Around two hundred and fifty individual Gurus, like the Parayi petta panthirukulam and the eighteen Siddhars, came. Their contemporaries did not allow anyone to do anything. Sikh Gurus were killed by being thrown into roasting sand. Sri Krishna was not even allowed to stay in this land. How did this destined karma come upon all of them, making them unable to execute the Divine Will? You must consider whether their actions stood in goodness or went astray.

Whatever kinds of defects there might have been, India is a land enriched by the birth of sages. How did such a land of India end up with such a misguided karmic path? All the Acharyas were those who endured sacrifices to improve humanity in every way. But how much goodness could we extract from their sacrifices? From what states did they operate? What were the transitions they went through? What were they able to achieve? What did they do before leaving? Only those with wisdom can evaluate their actions as having set the stage for a great sorrow.

Kali Yuga is the shortest period among the yugas. Various people speak of the length of the Kali Yuga in different ways. Some say five thousand years, others say four lakh thirty-two thousand years. There are also those who state a length between these two. Whatever the different time calculations regarding the length may be, the scenario presented to convince people that Kali is not good is not true. Is Kali really bad? When we look at all the different types of freedoms and rights humanity has gained in this yuga, Kali is never bad; it is the best. The reason Kali is called bad is because the dharma of Kali is not being practiced.

If the respective dharmas were practiced in Treta Yuga and Dvapara Yuga, and similarly if its dharma was practiced in Satya Yuga, shouldn't its dharma be practiced in Kali Yuga? It is because people did not know how to practice it that they declared Kali as destructive. Countless chaturyugas, more than one can count in a lifetime, have passed without practicing Kali. Our lifespan is such a short period that we cannot determine a chaturyuga in any way. Therefore, we are not capable of fulfilling the Yuga Dharma. Due to this reason, the weakness that has come upon us for a long time continues to afflict us. This affects not only India but the entire world.

Now let us look at the births of great souls. It was mentioned earlier that there are about twenty-five notable births in Islam and Christianity. How many sacrifices they have made for humanity! When we look at how many succeeded in implementing the Divine Will among them, it is not difficult for us to see that there is no one. The truth remains that the Yadava clan could not reap the fortune brought by the birth of Sri Krishna. Therefore, despite having around two thousand sages, yogis, and ascetics in India following Sri Krishna's birth, what all harms have befallen India! In Kerala alone, two or three great figures including Shankaracharya, and in other parts Jain and Buddha came, and they too got caught up in the extended stories of scholars. Because of all this, we suffered massive defeats. The reason for those defeats is that we did not become strong enough to internalize and act upon the teachings of these great ones.

We must start only from where these great souls stopped. Otherwise, we will just keep counting these defeats one by one and lie there. What purpose do we achieve by counting like that? Nothing. We must rely on the Guru who points out these mistakes. We must believe in such a Guru. If a thousand people believe like that, a true visionary aspect will be useful for only four or five people. Thus, out of a lakh people who might benefit from the vision, there will not be more than five who can be selected. Through these five, it will be revealed what we can achieve through this Guru in the light of all the Gurus who have come so far. That Guru is the seat of permanent peace for humanity.

A Vyazhavattam (Jovian cycle) is twelve years. This is the calculation of the rotation of the Earth, Sun, Moon - all nine planets. We can never take up the karmic path that has spun like this through ages. However, the experience here is that if the Guru is entirely capable, the vision of the great predecessors can be obtained through that Guru. These great souls will come in the light of this Guru and show the path. This is the complete proof that this Guru is entirely capable. How will such a Guru be useful in our lives? Even if useful, how will we accept it? Reach the path of this Guru in a way that gives liberation to everything that was worshipped ancestrally. This is success in life. After granting liberation, the Guru’s dharma is to take the karmic path that is mixed as gross, subtle, causal, and effect, and correct it for the disciple. This is the dharma of the Guru. Only the Guru who falls within that dharma is eternal peace. Completion of Vedanta, logical arguments, and debates are not going to be useful to us. We are not going to gain anything either.

There is vision in all religions. We also have a karmic path to perceive in what ways it exists. However, what we need to know is what weaknesses exist in the paths where predecessors were accepted in vision, yoga, devotion, and the path of action. The Guru who points out the remedy for that weakness to the disciple will make the disciple perform this remedy himself. It is not the Guru who should perform the remedy. Even if the Guru does it, it is only to correct the mistakes that might have occurred in the disciple's karma. Otherwise, the Guru must not do the action that the disciple is capable of doing. Because, if the Guru does it, that action will cease with the Guru's time. The karmic path lived out by the disciple for that purpose is the perfection of sacrifice. Learning and teaching the glories of that sacrifice is the true Guru-disciple relationship. The biggest matter is how much we have achieved in such a Guru-disciple relationship. Simply repeating, learning, and teaching what the Guru showed does not make a true Guru-disciple relationship. Bringing a disciple to this level is the Guru's sense of duty. This era, which has been fully granted to this lineage for this sense of duty, is the best indeed.
Guruvani
November 2000

We do nothing here except what God has ordained. What do you see as the greatest goodness here? The nature of the mind. The action of the mind is the greatest action. It is to not do wrongly, that is, as a betrayal, the things we know. All other mistakes are human nature. God placed human-natured mistakes. God Himself has to tolerate those mistakes. We have nothing to do there. Why did God place this? Why consider this a mistake? God placed this mistake to complete the action of creation, sustenance, and destruction. Only humans can complete that action. Animals cannot. Humans were given discretion. Within discretion, dharma was given. From dharma came merit, and from merit came fortune. The soul embedded in dharma within fortune will pave the way for liberation. It will take a lot of time to pass this knowledge on to children.

People assume that if they marry off a child in the house, they are saved. Parents say their suffocation has ended. In reality, that is the beginning of the suffocation. It is after that the fights start between the elder and the younger, the big and the small. Their children will never get along. There is a great danger in South Travancore. It is here that this alliance has happened the most. The filth combining all these sensible and senseless alliances has stuck to our souls. It is this soul that comes back as children and grandchildren. What more is needed for a never-ending trouble? We do not know any dharma. We must understand this and feel the pain. What do we say when we talk about dharma? We say, 'Is all this possible for humans, let it go.' If it just goes like that, where will this action be discarded? Therefore, we must have the determination that we can and must do this. Then we will be able to do this. Anyway, it is very difficult to raise these girls as children. While raising them, if we do not support their whims, they will scold us. I am speaking from the experience of seeing thousands of children. Cutting, stabbing, fighting, and stubbornness are the familiar traits of knowledge among us. We must understand this. This is an experience concerning everyone. There is no point in blaming each other for this. First, it is the mother and father who must understand this. Then they must tell their children with a pained heart. Without this, it cannot be corrected by sheer force. We never received the knowledge from anywhere that a father and mother should be like this. Without any of this knowledge, one simply grew up and became a father, a mother, a husband, a wife. We ourselves have made this animal-like life. Animals do not have the discretion to know all this. They do not need to know either. But what all does this human-animal do knowingly! We must understand this at least a little. Otherwise, just sitting at home and living as one pleases is not enough.

We do not have a home that is useful in that manner. This is the problem of human society. We think our home is good. It is not so; every house has this kind of problem. We have a way to escape from this. That is the Guru's path. In the Guru's path, all troubles will end. But we must grow in the spirit of dedication. When a life ends after fulfilling duties, we usually console ourselves saying everything is over. In reality, it is not so; their mischief has not ended. We must understand that life's struggles are left behind in the soul itself as one departs, not with everything resolved. We get an understanding regarding these mischiefs and struggles from the Guru's path.

Whatever we do, whether good or bad, must be done by uniting it with the Guru. That is Guru-smarana (remembrance of the Guru). That is how one can be saved. Otherwise, life is not going to find any salvation. What will we gain by boasting of greatness while holding on to all the mistakes? Keeping these troubles, we try to explain things to others as if we have understood everything. But first, we must have the realization of who we are, how bad we are, and how good we are. Then we should tell the children that there is such a painful phase in life. Do not tell them that you are perfect. If you say so, neither you nor they will be able to be saved. How much have I told you! But even if you understand it, either you are unable to take it. Or when you take it, mistakes happen. I see such a karma in all of you. If everyone does not try to change that karma, a lot of difficulties will arise.

When saying 'Ashram', you have only heard and assumed it to be a place with a Karmi, Jnani, Yogi, and the magical feats happening there. You have only this much understanding regarding the status of an ashram and deity worship. You don't even have the understanding that none of this has gone beyond a demonic state. We have been afflicted by the ignorance of making everything sound grand through the prowess of magical powers (siddhis), astounding the ignorant, and preaching Advaita completely to others. This is a truth given as God to bring a change to all this. If you do not intend to sanctify the life you have received by standing firm in that belief, I cannot do anything for you. If you act with your intellect and enter a dharma that gets ruined through your actions, no one will be able to correct you.

If you pay attention, you will understand one thing. Whatever anyone has done here, that karma has returned and joined them. And then they were lost in some way. This has happened even to the children who were first selected for the sake of vision. All of them went wrong and ruined themselves, but they couldn't do any good for this cause. Following that, Guru Puja was established here as God.

What is the knowledge of Guru Puja? This is not the system of gods or an isolated sleight of hand in the system of Siddhis. None of that belongs to God. If it is to belong to God, it should not be my sleight of hand or someone else's. This is a karma bestowed upon you for your salvation. From the experience of all this time, I have not been able to see this as anything separate from what is of God. This action is not opening the door to the theory that the material is different and the spiritual is different.

The spiritual and the material are like two sides of a coin. It is the truth contained in all humans. Let those who want the truth take the truth. Let others take the illusion. The worldly way is like that. As far as we are concerned, we must take the truth itself. For that to be possible, both men and women must feel the pain for it.

You yourself are seeing what the lifestyle that has come down through many ages is. Everyone, regardless of caste and religion differences, is seeing it. An example for this is Agastyankunju from Chandiroor. He is a Christian. He grew up playing with me. He has been seeing this for the last four years. He came and told me about seeing the life order of his many past births. A sight that a person cannot even imagine. How many such experiences have become evident here! What did you understand from this? This is not an action that can be shared by one caste or religion. Therefore, you should not ruin this by using your intellect.

I have a sorrow. I have shared with you my hardships and experiences up to this moment. You are not showing sincerity worth that. You have not demonstrated that sincerity in action. You have not acted on your own and subdued yourself, nor have you made someone else join and act in this. Then what is your capacity to act? Some good must come to this world through you. This is my desire. This is the intention behind keeping householders here in this state and nurturing them. Worldly karma must be fulfilled through householders. When permission was received to perform Guru Puja, God informed this. You are being made to do the life karma of many ages that God had set aside. It has also been announced that you will understand it. If you believe, love, and respect this in that manner, you will be able to carry this forward well. Do not assume that this is being done for me. This is a karma given by God. Do not cause flaws in this. If you cause such flaws, the defect of that karma will not leave your soul. Do not raise the boys and girls growing up in front of you in your own ways. You, who have grown up with love for caste, religion, and class, should not raise children like that. It is an injustice to this state.

If a word is received, if its timing is missed, that's it - doing it a second time will not make it right. How many experiences are there in front of you where things were lost by doing them at the wrong time! Do not assume that you can correct anyone by using intellect, deceit, and lies in karma. It will not happen. You must have a sense of karma and a sense of dharma matching that will. That sense of dharma must be turned into merit, and merit into fortune. It is that fortune you need. You should not behave here just to appease someone. If so, all the work you do will be in vain.

Even if a Guru has millions of disciples, that dharma will not last. Because the karmic defect capable of destroying all goodness is hanging above your heads. What will you do if you use your own intellect and deceit while trying to change that karmic defect? We are journeying towards the Yuga of truth by changing the culture of the tribes you were born into.

Satya Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dvapara Yuga. By acting completely well using Satya Yuga, the karma performed through Treta Yuga must be solidified. Just like the karmic path of origin. That karma must be solidified and completed when it reaches the end of Dvapara. This is creation, sustenance, and destruction.

What is creation, what is sustenance? The demonic possession residing in the five elements of this world is being merged into the five senses. The senses transfer it into the five sheaths (panchakoshas). Annamaya kosha is what operates into all cells. That is nature. That means we are seeing this entire nature operating in the annamaya kosha. If we want to change from such a nature, the word of truth given by God for that is to keep the word. Keep the Guru's word. There is no need to think about or keep anything else in this.

Keep the Guru's word as truth. When kept like that, an attribute of truth comes and joins within you. That attribute turns into you, and you become self-luminous (Swayam Jyothi). Setting aside all concepts of worship, it is affirmed:
Antarjyothi Bahirjyothi
Pratyagjyothi Paratpara
Jyothirjyothi Swayam Jyothi
Antarjyothi Shivosmyaham.
The light that is inherent in me is the external light. This external light will become self-luminous. That self-light is the Supreme Being. The self-light has merged into the soul of the Supreme.

Everyone is becoming this in this karma. Is it not ignorance to say that we cannot know, see, or hear this karmic ability that has poured into us? The karma of Santhigiri is to preserve as truth, through you, your children, and their lineage, this blessedness given to us as God by performing Guru Puja.
Guruvani
December 2000

The Guru is described in four ways - Brahmavit, Brahmavaryan, Brahmavarishtan, Brahmavareeshtan. The history and karmic ability that got altered when many wrote about it stand entangled around us like a great danger. We must take and see each one. Everywhere, the term 'egg' can be seen. An egg has a round shape, right? That is, from the initial stage of origin, it has taken the shape of the universe (Andakadaham). It reaches up to the amphibian, the turtle. From the pig, it has reached the evolution of the birth canal. There needs to be no better example than this to see that mistakes occurred right from the origin in the evolutionary path. It takes such a long time for a life to evolve into a state of giving birth. If we take and look at any object in the world, its evolutionary path is exactly like this.

If we think about the antiquity of time, we have the misfortune of not even being able to reach a few miles back. Therefore, it is appropriate to take the beginning of time from the period of Sri Krishna. Due to the twisting of stories regarding the tale of evolution, not a single Acharya could come forward and act. Some poets like Kunchan Nambiar and Ezhuthachan, who saw that this twisting of stories was not the truth, have spoken some truths. Since they couldn't state that openly either, they said it according to their abilities. Looking back, even if one studies many great Vedantins, theorists, karmis, jnanis, and devotees, nothing can be understood. While each wrote and highlighted that part of their capability, deviations in the path over time occurred. If a Guru lineage is not attained in the state change of this clan, the mistakes cannot be corrected. Even if a new thought originates, it will have no connection with spirituality. It is the same when looking at the position of education. A lifetime might pass well due to the goodness of knowledge. The story of Kalidasa is also one such twisted story. Stories like the shepherd boy marrying the princess, and when asked 'who is inside' replying 'who is outside', got twisted, creating a situation where no one could speak the truth. Story writing across India is just like this. Hanuman, a great devotee, and Sri Rama, a great noble soul who lived at that time, got caught in this twisting of stories.

Seeing all this, it feels as if they embraced it just to avoid dying by making mistakes in the karma that completely shook the dharma of India. In whichever yugas and through whichever yuga dharmas however many great men came, all poets and religious believers together have twisted and preserved stories according to the capacity of their language. Due to this reason, performing worship of God truthfully became impossible. Conforming to what was written in these stories, they tried to bring it into action to gain karmic capability, and kept it grasped and imparted in the intellect. This led to the destruction of karma. These scholars also have the responsibility to say whether this karma that led to destruction is true or false. There are some scholars included in this. They are the four types of Gurus, starting with Brahmavit, mentioned earlier.

These four groups shrank to three. This means the fourth face of knowledge (Nanmukhatvam) disappeared, and consequently, the dharma of Kali did not occur. This loss of dharma grows alongside the world. As a result, philosophies became intellectual brawls decorated with language and embellishments. If one starts calling God in this path, from where would one have to call, and where would it lead? Intellectually saying that this negative aspect in the worship of God is neither old nor new does not make it disappear.

This has become nature. Nature never disappears. Even if intellect is poured completely, or even if the administration of a country is obtained, this cannot be fixed. The parts in philosophies that say what exists does not exist and what does not exist exists have hindered the growth of great souls. Thus, scholars wrote and established their respective parts, and all poets who came to this day growing it in a ruined way have kept the world as a concubine. The stories of the shepherd boy marrying the princess and attaching a tail to Hanuman despite him being Rama's greatest devotee are examples of this. Dharma cannot be completed by holding onto these foolish stories. There is no point in holding onto them either.

Saying it shouldn't be held onto does not mean it doesn't exist. Whatever is uttered by name does exist. When we say 'us', do not assume it means only Indians. This mistake has afflicted the entire world. Hence, all rulers of the world have erred. When the children of each of these individuals are born and grow, their task is to become frenzied entities of mischief. In the end, the leg pain will be the same for the one who ran and the one who made others run.

When some scholars who lacked God's grace and their followers wrote stories and turned them into Kathakali, their drama composition was in such a way that they used the Guru or Prophet to enlarge the stage of the play. Vyasa was the one who came to correct this method. But what did Vyasa write down? He divided it into four faces and made four Vedas. Even before that, it had been made into six shastras and eighteen puranas. Vyasa came to correct that. They stand as hymns of praise, but is it easy to rewrite and reclaim all of them? Therefore, we do not need to look in that direction.

This knowledge we have received was shown by God. What we have found today is a karma that needs to be taken up by fully believing, respecting, and loving it. The Sun, Moon, and Earth continue to rotate without losing balance. Two phases, the dark phase and the bright phase, have been declaring results based on twenty-seven stars. They also tried to liberate the physics of the earth by putting it in the calculation of yamas and telling the story of the global sphere. Such mistakes have been made regarding all celestial bodies. This cannot be attained by thinking. These scholars themselves have said that it is beyond thought, beyond intellect. Their principles are seen theorized in many ways as darshana and yoga. No one should even touch any of this. Gurus are needed to handle this. The Guru path intended here is not the one that has come in our concepts and knowledge.

The curse of Brahma exists from whichever time Manu dharma was violated. It is not possible for an educated person or an uneducated person to fulfill it. However, there are many great souls who come by divine will. Twenty-one such Gurus will come in one Chaturyuga. They will not write down anything to convince anyone. The dharma of these Gurus is to see the rights and wrongs of the past times and correct them. At the same time, it is not possible for him to change the structural attributes that have come through the mistakes. How many Ramas, how many Buddhas, how many Jesuses and Prophets have come! Have they been able to do anything for the human world other than bear witness with pain? When the tongue and mouth did not yield to their knowledge, they rejected it and strengthened the three faces. They also wrote down that the face of knowledge was plucked off. Even if written like that, karma is not going to leave the realm where it was performed. Whether seen with the mind or the physical eye, it exists as atmospheric impurities.
Whenever great souls come, God gives them the necessary intellect and ability. But we have only troubled and ruined all these great ones.

The simplicity of a disciple is seeing how the gross and subtle, and the causes and effects, which stand beyond thought, occurred in all times. If it goes through the twisting of stories, this disciple will fall into a pit. But if he goes through the Guru who actually came, this mistake will not happen. This Guru will not show any superiority. This Guru will be capable of giving the account of twenty-five chaturyugas. One can travel through all karmas by holding onto this Guru. The disciple with vision sees both the Guru and himself present in all these karmas. Upon seeing it, he will tell the Guru and receive corrections.

The lineage of the Trinity and the lineage of Manu are not non-existent. Let that truth remain there. What we have to see is something else. What all types of eggs are there in the universe (Andakadaham) which is in the shape of an egg! What all will be included in that egg; all the previously mentioned lights will come into it. Whether we see that light or not, believers and loving people together must respect Sri Narayana Guru's word that 'the deity should be placed in the service of sages'. In that position, there is no difference of male or female, small or big. Correct the mistakes of the world and move forward. This is the duty of a true disciple. This disciple is what can be called discipleship wealth. I am informing you of the truth that it is utilized in this manner in Santhigiri.
Guruvani
